title: QA Developer (with Lovable experience)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

QA & Development Support Specialist — Vibe Coding

Platforms



About the Role

Our client builds and ships products using AI-assisted “vibe coding” platforms — currently

Lovable, with more platforms likely to follow. We're looking for a hands-on Virtual Assistant

who can go beyond surface-level testing: someone who understands what's actually

happening under the hood of these AI-generated builds, can catch bugs before users do, and

can open the code and fix it directly when something breaks.



This is not a general VA role. It's for someone who is comfortable clicking through an app AND

comfortable in a codebase — reading components, tracing a bug to its source, and shipping a

fix without needing a developer to hold their hand.



What You'll Be Doing

• Perform structured QA on apps built in Lovable (and future vibe coding platforms):

functional testing, edge cases, responsive/mobile checks, cross-browser checks.

• Reproduce bugs, document them clearly (steps, expected vs. actual, screenshots/screen

recordings), and track them to resolution.

• Open the underlying codebase, understand what the AI generated, and fix bugs directly —

front-end, back-end, or database/config level as needed.

• Review AI-generated code for quality issues before they become problems: broken logic,

security gaps, messy state management, unnecessary complexity.

• Test integrations (auth, payments, APIs, database/Supabase-style backends) end-to-end,

not just the UI layer.

• Flag when a bug is a platform limitation vs. something fixable in code, and recommend the

right approach.

• Keep a lightweight QA log/tracker per project so issues and fixes are visible to the client.

• Work across multiple concurrent projects as the client's product portfolio grows beyond

the current Lovable build.



What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

• Hands-on experience with at least one AI/vibe coding platform (Lovable, Bolt, Replit Agent,

Cursor, v0, or similar) — either building on it or fixing what it produces.

• Solid working knowledge of the underlying stack these platforms generate: React/Next.js,

JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, and typically Supabase or a similar backend-as-a-service.

• Comfortable reading someone else's (or an AI's) code, not just writing your own from

scratch.

• Strong QA instincts: methodical, detail-obsessed, thinks in edge cases rather than just

“does it load.”

• Can debug independently — reads error logs, uses browser dev tools, isolates root cause

before asking for help.

• Clear written communication in English — bug reports and status updates need to be

understandable without a call.

• Reliable availability and responsiveness; this role supports active, moving projects.



Nice-to-Haves

• Experience with Supabase, Firebase, or similar (auth, database, storage, edge functions).

• Familiarity with Git/GitHub for version control and code review.

• Exposure to API integrations (Stripe, third-party SaaS APIs, webhooks).

• Background in software QA/testing methodology (test cases, regression testing, bug

tracking tools like Jira/Linear/ClickUp).

• Basic understanding of security and performance basics (input validation, avoiding

exposed keys, load times).



Tools You'll Likely Use

• Lovable (primary platform currently in use)

• Browser dev tools, and/or an IDE (VS Code) for direct code edits

• Supabase or equivalent backend dashboard

• GitHub for version history

• [Project management / bug tracking tool — to be confirmed]



How to Apply

Please submit:

1. Updated CV and Introduction Video

2. Active Whatsapp Number

3. A short summary of your experience with vibe coding platforms (which ones, what you

built or fixed).

4. 1–2 examples of bugs you've diagnosed and fixed in an AI-generated or unfamiliar

codebase (links, write-ups, or before/after descriptions welcome).

5. Earliest availability to start

title: Research VA — Build a Shortlist of EU Slaughterhouses
description:
We're an established meat manufacturing company based in Poland, operating for over 30 years with over 80 employees. This is a real, registered business — not an agency or a middleman — and you'll be working directly with our team.



We need a detail-focused VA to help us build a verified directory of slaughterhouses in Europe.



The raw data you will work with is public and free (official EU TRACES directory — we'll provide you instructions on how to work with that directory). Your job: check each company on Google Maps and Google, then tell us if it's a real, decent-sized business worth calling — or a tiny backyard operation that we shouldn't bother calling.



What you'll do



Check the address provided in the official EU Traces directory on Google Maps (satellite view) and search for their website

In case the company looks promising, copy the company name and website link into our Google Sheet so that this lead can be pursued later down the line





ADD = big industrial buildings, multiple trucks, real website.

SKIP = house or small farm building, no website, no serious business.

When you are unsure if something qualifies, you can ask us for our insight anytime



You need: good written English, real attention to detail, Google Sheets, a computer and stable internet. No meat industry experience needed — we'll train you with a tailored guide and 10 example rows.



Hours & pay: 36 hrs/week, flexible schedule. $4/hour, paid weekly on WISE, we can make daily payouts at first to build trust





To apply, send:



The word BEEF at the top

2–3 sentences on any research or list-building work you've done

Answer this: A slaughterhouse has no website, but satellite view shows five large buildings and 20 trucks parked outside. ADD, SKIP, or UNSURE — and why?

title: C# / .NET Desktop Developer — Windows Agent
description:
Contract:  Fixed-scope contract project

Engagement:  Project-Based

Location:  Remote — must overlap Australia / Sydney business hours (AEST/AEDT)

Time Tracking:  TimeDoctor (screenshots + activity tracking) — required for the duration of the contract

Experience:  8+ years professional C# / .NET development and PHP Laravel 

Working hours:  40 hour/week Monday to Friday



About the Project

We’re building the desktop agent for a cloud-connected application. The agent is a small Windows 11 application that runs on a customer’s PC. It connects to a variety of payment gateways in the local network and forwards communications to our cloud backend via REST API. This is a self-contained build with a clear spec. You’ll own the agent end to end, working against our documented integration interfaces and cloud API. You’ll need to create new APIs if requires.



What the Agent Does

• Polls and communicates with local payment gateway using a variety of methods: HTTP/JSON API calls, file-based data exchange, and local URL/API interfaces — listing records and fetching individual entries and etc.

• Parses data payloads in multiple formats including XML, CSV, JSON and plain text. The XML can contain binary sections, so byte-fidelity matters.

• Maintains a persistent secure connection to the cloud (WebSocket Secure / WSS on port 443, outbound-initiated for NAT/firewall friendliness) plus an HTTPS REST channel for pushing data.

• Queues and pushes completed records to a REST API as a JSON envelope (XML embedded as base64), handling retries, duplicates, and connectivity drops gracefully.

• Shows a lightweight UI for status, connection state, and basic operator actions.



Recommended architecture (open to discussion): a headless background worker / Windows Service for all connectivity and queueing, with a thin WPF UI on top. The workload is I/O-bound, not compute-heavy.



Requirements

Hardware & Environment

• Must have your own computer running Windows 11 — the agent targets Windows 11 and you’ll need to build, run, and test on it natively.



Experience & Skills

• 8+ years building production C# / .NET applications (.NET 8 or later).

• 3+ years building production PHP Laravel applications (version 11+)

• Windows desktop development — WPF (or strong WinForms/desktop background to ramp quickly).

• REST APIs — confident consuming HTTP/JSON services with HttpClient: auth headers / bearer tokens, status-code handling, retries/backoff, idempotency.

• Web services in general — understands HTTP semantics, JSON, request/response contracts, and how clients behave behind NAT/firewalls.

• XML, CSV, JSON and text data formats — solid working knowledge: parsing and reading structured XML (XDocument / XmlReader), navigating a schema (XSD), handling encoded/binary content cleanly; reading and writing CSV and plain-text data files.

• Async I/O patterns (async/await, cancellation, ClientWebSocket).

• Resilience — sensible error handling, logging, reconnect/backoff, and offline queueing.

• Able to work independently — self-directed and comfortable owning a component end to end with minimal supervision.

• Testing & QA — can write unit and integration tests, perform manual QA, identify and log defects, and verify fixes against acceptance criteria.

• Agentic Coding — familiar of Claude Code in coding, testing, review in the workflow.

• Project Management — capable of taking on lightweight PM tasks: tracking milestones, updating task status, flagging blockers proactively, and estimating remaining effort.

• Security Awareness  — aware of data sensitivity and handling.   

• Good verbal and written communication in English — clear and professional in async written communication (Slack, Jira, Confluence) and comfortable in spoken sync calls.



Tools & Workflow

• Comfortable working in our toolchain: Jira (issues/sprints), Confluence (docs), Postman (API testing), Sentry (error monitoring), and Bitbucket (source control / pull requests).

• Clean commits, clear pull requests, and clear written communication in English.



Nice to Have

• WebSocket clients (ClientWebSocket) and/or a Pusher-style real-time relay client.

• Windows Service / background host packaging and installer experience (MSIX, WiX, or similar).

• Experience integrating with payment gateway on a local network using varied communication protocols.

• Background working against a Laravel/PHP backend (you consume the API; extra PHP work is required).



Working Arrangement

• Project-based / fixed scope. We’ll agree milestones and deliverables up front.

• Sydney business-hour overlap required for daily sync and quick turnaround on questions. A minimum of  6 hours of genuine overlap each working day is required — you don’t need to be Sydney-based.

• TimeDoctor is used for time tracking and is a condition of the engagement; please only apply if you’re comfortable with activity monitoring.

• Resources provided: code, device API documentation, and XML schemas (XSD). You’ll have access to a staging cloud environment to test against.



Deliverables

• A working, installable Windows 11 agent that communicates with payment gateway, parses data in XML/CSV/JSON/text formats, and pushes records to the cloud API per spec.

• Reconnection / offline-queue handling that survives network drops and PC restarts.

• Source code in our Bitbucket repo, with a brief README covering build, configuration, and install.

• Basic logging suitable for diagnosing field issues.

• Full deployment script and solution. 



How to Apply

Please include:

• Relevant C#/.NET desktop and REST integration work — links or descriptions of comparable projects.

• Relevant PHP Laravel work — links or descriptions of comparable projects.

• Your experience with XML/CSV/JSON text parsing and any WebSocket / real-time work.

• Examples of working independently and owning a project component end to end.

• Any Testing, QA, or light project management experience.

• Your time-zone and the daily hours you can overlap with Sydney.

• Confirmation you run Windows 11 and are comfortable using TimeDoctor, Jira, Confluence, Postman, Sentry, and Bitbucket.

• A rough estimate / milestone breakdown for a project of this shape, and your rate.



Candidates who address the multi-device integration, data-format handling, and secure-push flow directly (rather than a generic CV) will be prioritised.

title: Senior PHP / Laravel Developer — General Requirements
description:
Contract: 12-week initial term, extension expected

Engagement: Project-Based

Location: Remote — must overlap Australia / Sydney business hours (AEST/AEDT)

Time Tracking: TimeDoctor (screenshots + activity tracking) — required for the duration of the contract

Experience: 8+ years professional PHP / Laravel development

Working hours: 40 hours/week Monday to Friday

Positions: 3 — Clinical & Supplier Integrations, Business & Financial Integrations, Product Features

About the Project

We build and run a multi-tenant practice management platform used by healthcare clinics — patient records, appointments, clinical notes, prescriptions, invoicing, and reporting. The platform is a set of interconnected Laravel applications sharing a central PostgreSQL database, and we are progressively rewriting our main portal into Laravel + Livewire 3.

We are hiring three senior Laravel developers. All three sit on the same platform and share the same bar; they differ in what each owns. This document is the baseline every candidate must clear before their specialisation is considered. Each role has its own job description covering what it adds on top.

The Three Positions

• Clinical & Supplier Integrations — supplier and laboratory ordering systems, health-claims and rebate platforms, partner clinical networks. Correctness over speed.

• Business & Financial Integrations — accounting platforms,
 and calendar providers, payment terminals and banking APIs. Money and communications, both unforgiving.

• Product Features — new customer-facing features including AI-assisted clinical documentation and self-service financial tooling. UI-forward; the only role where Livewire is a hard requirement.

Requirements

Experience & Skills

• 8+ years building production PHP applications, with at least 5 years in Laravel (Laravel 9+), hands-on and current. Not “I led a team that used Laravel”.

• Large or long-lived production systems — code with history, constraints you did not choose, and users who noticed when it broke. A string of greenfield builds is a different kind of experience; this platform is not a greenfield.

• You have owned something in production — not just built it, but carried it, watched it fail, and fixed it. Be ready to talk about a specific failure in detail.

• Eloquent at depth — relationships, eager loading, query performance, and knowing when to drop to the query builder or raw SQL instead.

• Strong SQL — non-trivial queries, joins, indexes, and the ability to read a query plan and act on it. PostgreSQL preferred; MySQL transfers fine.

• Queues and background jobs — Laravel queues, Horizon, Supervisor or equivalent. You have debugged a job that failed silently in production.

• REST and web services in general — HTTP semantics, auth headers / bearer tokens, status-code handling, retries/backoff, idempotency, and what happens when a request times out mid-write.

• Reading code you didn’t write — much of this work is understanding existing systems before changing them. Comfort navigating an unfamiliar codebase is essential.

• Multi-tenant awareness — every record here is scoped by account and practice; getting that wrong is a data-leak class of bug, not a cosmetic one.

• Able to work independently — self-directed and comfortable owning a component end to end with minimal supervision.

• Testing & QA — can write unit and feature tests (Pest or PHPUnit), perform manual QA, identify and log defects, and verify fixes against acceptance criteria.

• Agentic Coding — familiar with Claude Code in coding, testing, and review in the workflow.

• Project Management — capable of lightweight PM tasks: tracking milestones, updating task status, flagging blockers proactively, and estimating remaining effort.

• Security Awareness — aware of data sensitivity and handling. This platform holds patient and financial records.

• Good verbal and written communication in English — clear and professional in async written communication (Slack, Jira, Confluence) and comfortable in spoken sync calls.

Tools & Workflow

• Comfortable working in our toolchain: Jira (issues/sprints), Confluence (docs), Postman (API testing), Sentry (error monitoring), and Bitbucket (source control / pull requests).

• Clean commits, clear pull requests, and clear written communication in English.

Not Required

Worth stating plainly, because it widens the pool without lowering the bar:

• A degree. We care about what you’ve shipped.

• Livewire — except for the Product Features role, where it is a hard requirement.

• Tailwind or Alpine specifically — the fundamentals underneath them are what matter.

• Python or Django — helpful for reading legacy business logic, not a requirement.

• Healthcare or clinical software background — useful context, genuinely not a hard requirement.

• PostgreSQL specifically — strong MySQL transfers fine.

Working Arrangement

• Project-based. 12-week initial term with milestones agreed up front. Extension expected for the right person.

• Sydney business-hour overlap required for daily sync and quick turnaround on questions. A minimum of 6 hours of genuine overlap each working day is required — you don’t need to be Sydney-based.

• TimeDoctor is used for time tracking and is a condition of the engagement; please only apply if you’re comfortable with activity monitoring.

• Resources provided: codebase access, database schema documentation, and a staging environment to test against.

How to Apply

Please include:

• Which of the three positions fits you best and why. If more than one does, say so — we’d rather place you well than fill a slot.

• Relevant Laravel work — links or descriptions of comparable projects, and what you owned on them.

• Links to any code you’ve written — GitHub, GitLab, personal projects, anything.

• Your experience with agentic coding tools — which you’ve genuinely used, one task you completed with one, and one time the tool got it wrong and how you caught it.

• Examples of working independently and owning a component end to end.

• Any Testing, QA, or light project management experience.

• Your time-zone and the daily hours you can overlap with Sydney.

• Confirmation you’re comfortable using TimeDoctor, Jira, Confluence, Postman, Sentry, and Bitbucket.

• A rough estimate / milestone breakdown for work of this shape, and your rate.

Candidates who name the position they’re targeting and address its specifics directly (rather than a generic CV) will be prioritised.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Poker Content (Templates Provided, Ongoing Work)
description:
I run a poker content channel and I need one reliable editor to take over my short-form edits. This is ongoing work with steady weekly volume, not a one-off project.



**These videos have no voiceover.** 

A poker hand plays out on screen and the graphics explain what's happening. That means your cut, your graphics timing, and your sound design carry the entire video. If a viewer scrolls past, that's an editing outcome.



Here's the part that should interest you: 

**you are not designing anything from scratch.** 

I provide the templates, the brand assets, every number that goes on screen, and reference videos showing exactly the style I want. The creative direction is already decided. Your job is to execute it cleanly, quickly, and consistently.



I currently edit these myself in 1–2 hours each. That's the target you're working toward.





## What You'll Be Doing



Per video (30–60 seconds, vertical 9:16):



- **Cut the hand down** — remove folds, dead time, menu navigation, anything between the moments that matter. Every second has to earn its place.

- **Drop in money graphics** using my templates — pot size, stack sizes, bet amounts. I give you the numbers; you place and time them.

- **Lay out the board properly** — the runout has to be instantly readable on a phone held at arm's length. This is the detail most editors get wrong.

- **Sound design** — chip and card SFX, risers into big decisions, impact on the reveal, and knowing when to drop to silence before a big moment. This is the part templates can't do for you.

- **Hook the first 1.5 seconds** — the opening frame decides whether the video gets watched.

- **Music selection and mix** from my approved library

- **Export to spec** and deliver to Google Drive





## What I Provide



- Raw footage

- All graphics templates, already built

- Every callout value (pot, stacks, bet sizing) written out for you

- Brand assets, fonts, color palette

- Approved music and SFX library

- 3+ reference videos showing the exact style

- A shot sheet per video noting anything specific I want emphasized



## Requirements



- **2+ years editing short-form vertical content.** Send real examples you personally edited — not a showreel, not team work you assisted on.

- **Adobe Premiere Pro or After Effects** (my templates are built in [Premiere/AE] — you need to work in that program)

- **Real sound design ability.** Send at least one example where the sound is doing actual work, not just background music. This is the skill I'm screening hardest for.

- **You follow references precisely.** With templates and examples provided, off-style output means you didn't look closely. That's the fastest way to not get hired here.

- **Detail obsession with numbers.** A wrong stack size on screen makes the whole channel look amateur.

- **Turnaround:** 24 hours per video, consistently

- Stable internet for 2gb file transfers



## Nice to Have



- Any poker experience, recreational counts

- Understanding of retention editing and hook structure

- Thumbnail or cover frame design



## What You Get



- Predictable weekly volume and a guaranteed monthly minimum

- Everything prepped for you — no client calls, no creative guesswork, no chasing assets

- Rate increases as volume grows

- Fast, direct feedback and payment weekly on schedule

- Long-term role





## How to Apply



Read carefully. Applications that skip a step get deleted.



1. Start your message with the word **RIVER**.

2. Send **2 links** to vertical short-form videos you personally edited. Say exactly what you did on each.

3. Send **1 example where your sound design is doing the work.** Tell me what you were going for.

4. Tell me which program you edit in and how long you've used it.

5. Answer: with templates and all values provided, how long would a 45-second vertical edit realistically take you?

6. Confirm you can handle 7 videos per week.



Shortlist gets a **paid test edit — $20 flat**, whether or not I hire you. I don't ask for free work.

title: Intake / Referral Coordinator - Healthcare / Therapy
description:
The Intake/Referral Coordinator is the primary point of contact between referring agencies (home health agencies, case managers, and other partners) and our clinical team. This role manages the full referral lifecycle : receiving and triaging incoming patient referrals, coordinating with clinicians to confirm availability and acceptance, communicating decisions back to referral sources, and ensuring accepted patients are accurately entered into the EMR system. 



This position is for 9am to 5pm EST , Monday through Friday. This is high volume and requires constant monitoring. 



The ideal candidate is highly responsive, organized, and comfortable managing a high volume of time-sensitive requests across multiple communication channels.



Key Responsibilities:

-Serve as the first point of contact for incoming patient referrals from home health agencies, case managers, and other referral sources via
.

-Review referral details (patient name, address, diagnosis/discipline needed — PT, OT, ST, PTA, COTA, etc.) and determine coverage area and staffing feasibility.

-Reach out to clinicians via Slack and RingCentral to confirm availability and secure acceptance of new patients.

-Communicate staffing decisions (accept, decline, waitlist/backup) back to referring agencies promptly and professionally via
.

-Coordinate scheduling details with referral sources, including eval dates, discipline assignments, and any special case requirements (e.g., urgent starts, discharge/transfer coordination).

-Accurately enter and update accepted patient information in the EMR system once clinician acceptance is confirmed.

-Track referrals that are pending, on backup/waitlist status, or cancelled, and follow up as needed to keep referral sources informed.

-Maintain ongoing communication with referral partners to manage case updates, cancellations, and changes in patient status or location.

-Monitor and relay communicaitons

-Build and maintain strong working relationships with referral sources to support consistent patient volume.



Required Skills & Qualifications

-Prior experience in healthcare intake, referral coordination, medical office administration, or home health/rehab scheduling preferred.

-Excellent written communication skills; comfortable managing a high volume of
 correspondence professionally and efficiently.

-Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask across many simultaneous, time-sensitive referrals.

Experience with (or ability to quickly learn) EMR/EHR systems.

-Comfortable using Slack and RingCentral (or similar messaging/VoIP platforms) for internal and clinician communication.

-Familiarity with therapy disciplines (PT, OT, ST, PTA, COTA) and home health referral processes is a strong plus.

-Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy in data entry.

-Able to work independently, prioritize competing requests, and respond quickly during business hours.

Work Environment

-This role is primarily computer- and phone-based, requiring sustained
 correspondence, messaging, and coordination throughout the day. Fast response times are essential, as referral sources often expect same-day (and sometimes same-hour) confirmation of patient acceptance.

title: Real Estate SMS Manager
description:
SMS Manager (Real Estate Acquisitions, Launch Control)



We run off-market Acquisitions in the United States and are hiring an SMS Manager to own our seller text outreach end to end. You will build and load lists, launch and pace campaigns in Launch Control and/or Smarter Contact, protect deliverability, and get qualified replies to the acquisitions team fast.



What you will own



Campaigns: Build, launch, schedule, and pace campaigns in Launch Control. Manage sending numbers, rotation, and campaign naming so results stay traceable.



Reply handling: Monitor inbound replies during your shift, respond using the approved qualification script, and route qualified sellers to acquisitions immediately. You will not improvise messaging or go off script.



Lists and data: Pull property and owner records in PropStream, run skip tracing, and deliver clean, deduplicated, correctly mapped upload files. Scrub DNC and prior opt outs before every send.



Deliverability: Track delivery rates, carrier filtering, and number health. Verify spintax and merge field syntax before launch. Flag drops in delivery before they cost us send volume.



Compliance: Maintain opt out and DNC records, follow TCPA and Florida FTSA requirements, and keep 10DLC registration details accurate.



Reporting: Daily numbers on sends, delivery rate, reply rate, qualified leads, and cost per qualified lead, with a short note on what changed and why.



Testing: Run controlled tests on approved message variants, segments, and send timing. One variable at a time. Report the result.



Targets you will be measured on



Delivery rate above 90 percent

Reply response time under 5 minutes during shift hours

Qualified leads per 1,000 sends, tracked and improving month over month

Zero compliance incidents

What this role is not



No outbound calls. No appointment setting. No negotiating price with sellers. Text execution and data only.



Requirements



Hands on experience running SMS campaigns in Launch Control and Smarter Contact. This is required and will be verified in a test task.

Working experience in PropStream or a comparable data platform, including polygon and filter based list pulls.

Skip tracing experience (KindSkiptracing, BatchSkipTracing, or similar).

Strong spreadsheet and data hygiene skills: deduplication, field mapping, formatting for upload.

Understanding of SMS deliverability: carrier filtering, number health, spintax, merge fields.

Written English strong enough to handle live seller replies without sounding scripted or foreign to a US reader.

Reliable overlap with 9am to 6pm US Eastern.

CRM experience, Salesforce preferred but not required.



$4-$5/hour, with an incentive program which will be based around response rates and conversion rates.

title: Bookkeeping Specialist — Contractor Finance
description:
About Us



Vantage Financial is a financial-operations company built specifically for contractors and construction businesses. Most bookkeepers treat every industry the same — general categorization, a P&L at year-end, and not much else. We don't. We work exclusively with residential and commercial contractors, helping them get their books fully organized, understand exactly which jobs are actually making them money, and position themselves to access real business capital — 0% business credit cards, lines of credit, and equipment financing — without guessing or applying blind.



We're a growing company, and this role is a foundational hire on our operations team. As we bring on more contractor clients, this position has real room to grow — from managing a handful of accounts to eventually overseeing a team of bookkeepers as we scale.



About the Role



This is a hands-on, full-cycle bookkeeping and job costing role, not a data-entry position. You'll be the person actually responsible for making sure our contractor clients' books are clean, accurate, and — most importantly — broken down job by job, so every client can see exactly what each project actually cost them and what it actually made them.



Day to day, that means managing bank and credit card feeds inside QuickBooks Online, reconciling accounts monthly, and using the Projects feature to tag every transaction — materials, labor, subcontractor costs — to the correct job. You'll be working across multiple contractor accounts at once, so strong organization and attention to detail matter as much as bookkeeping accuracy itself. You'll also need to understand contractor-specific accounting realities most bookkeepers never deal with — job costing, work-in-progress, retainage, and separating owner draws from real business expenses.



This role sits at the center of what we deliver to clients, so accuracy and consistency matter — a mistagged transaction or a missed reconciliation directly affects the numbers a client is making real business decisions on.



What You'll Do

title: 2D Anime Fight / Action Animator — $1,000/Month
description:
Lamb Light Studio is producing a long-term Christian anime series, **Stand Firm: A Light in the Shadows**, and we're looking for a talented **2D fight/action animator** to join our production team.



**This position is specifically for FIGHT SCENES.**



Sword fights. Fast movement. Dodging. Impact shots. Dynamic camera angles. Character combat. Anime-style action.



If action animation is one of your strongest skills, we want to see your work.



### Project References



**Official Trailer — 230K+ Views**





**Recent Project Upload**





These videos show the characters, visual direction, tone, and quality we're building toward.



---



## What You'll Be Doing



Your primary responsibility will be creating **full rough animation for fight/action sequences**.



You will:



* Create hand-drawn, frame-by-frame 2D rough animation

* Animate sword combat, attacks, dodges, running, jumping, impacts, etc.

* Create dynamic action poses and convincing movement

* Handle camera movement and changing perspectives during combat

* Establish timing, spacing, weight, speed, and impact

* Work from scripts, references, character sheets, and director notes

* Create rough layouts/background blocking when necessary for perspective

* Deliver animation that can move into cleanup/color without needing to be reanimated

* Keep Clip Studio Paint files organized for the rest of the production team



**You do NOT need to color the animation.**



Other members of the team will handle backgrounds, coloring, compositing, and other stages of production.



We want you focused on what you do best:



**Making the fights look GOOD.**



---



# Compensation



**$500–$1,000 USD/month depending on output, experience, and quality.**



$100 per 1 minute



Our current target is approximately **5 minutes of completed rough animation per month**, with the possibility of additional work up to approximately **10 minutes** depending on the complexity of the scenes and your production speed.



We understand that not every minute of animation requires the same amount of work. A highly complex fight sequence may require considerably more time than a simpler action sequence.



Quality, consistency, and communication matter more than simply rushing to hit a minute count.



Payment through PayPal.



Flexible working schedule.



This is intended to become a **long-term position** for the right animator as the project continues to grow.



---



# Paid Animation Test



Selected applicants may be offered a **PAID $50 animation test**.



The test will be approximately **20 seconds** using our characters and action direction.



We are not expecting final polished/color animation.



We want to see:



* Motion

* Timing

* Choreography

* Perspective

* Character consistency

* Camera movement

* Impact

* Ability to follow direction

* Communication and reliability



**The test is paid whether or not you are ultimately selected for the long-term position, provided the agreed test is completed and delivered.**



Strong performance on the test may lead directly to paid production work.



---



# What We're Looking For



You may be a good fit if:



* Fight/action animation is one of your strongest skills

* You understand anime-style action

* You have strong motion, timing, posing, and staging

* You can animate characters from multiple perspectives

* You're comfortable with hand-to-hand and/or weapon combat

* You're comfortable working in rough animation

* You can work without every frame being storyboarded for you

* You communicate consistently

* You can meet agreed deadlines

* You're comfortable working with **Christian themes**

* You can work in **Clip Studio Paint**



You do **not** need the world's biggest portfolio.



If you're talented but still building your professional portfolio, we're willing to give you an opportunity to prove yourself through the paid test.



---



# How to Apply



Please send:



1. **Your portfolio**



   Fight scenes, action animation, rough animation, unfinished animation, and personal animation tests are strongly encouraged.



2. **Your best fight/action animation sample**



   If you only want us to watch ONE piece of your work, tell us which one.



3. **Your availability**



   Include your hours per week and time zone.



4. **Your Clip Studio Paint experience**



5. Answer the questions below.



### Application Questions



**1. What type of action are you strongest at?**

Sword fighting, hand-to-hand combat, fast movement, effects, dynamic camera work, etc.



**2. Have you animated a fight scene before?**

Please provide a link if possible.



**3. How many minutes of FULL rough animation could you realistically produce per month?**



Please give us a realistic answer. We would rather have an honest estimate than an exaggerated one.



**4. Roughly how long would it take you to rough animate a 20-second high-action fight sequence?**



**5. Are you comfortable animating directly from a script, character sheets, references, and director instructions without a complete storyboard?**



**6. What are your biggest strengths as an animator?**



**7. What type of animation do you struggle with the most?**



**8. How many hours per week can you consistently commit over the next several months?**



**9. Are you willing to complete a paid $50 / approximately 20-second animation test if selected?**



---



## Important



We're building a small team, so **reliability matters just as much as talent.**



You don't have to be the fastest animator.



You don't have to create perfect drawings during the rough stage.



But if you accept an assignment, we need consistent communication and progress.



We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys animating action and wants the opportunity to help create memorable anime fight scenes.



If that's you, **show us what you can do.**

Final files delivered ready to post — no additional steps required on our end



Once selected

The successful candidate will be given Marlow's full project brief — covering editing style, colour grading, hook structure, and retention strategy — and will be expected to follow it strictly. This isn't a loose style guide; it's the standard every reel is measured against.

You call property owners from a prioritized list, find the ones with a real reason to sell, qualify them on condition, timeline, motivation and price, and set the appointment for me. You work inside my own custom-built CRM — it scores every lead, tells you exactly who to call next and why they are motivated, and logs the call while you talk. You will never buy your own data or guess who to dial.



Hours: US Central time, Monday to Friday, full time.



PAY — IT GOES UP ON A SCHEDULE, NOT "SOMEDAY"

- Start: $4.25/hour

- Day 60, once you are hitting targets: $4.60/hour

- Month 6: $5.00/hour — the top of my caller band

- Month 12: first in line for Acquisitions Manager, which pays above the caller band plus deal commission



BONUSES ON TOP — NO CAP

- $10 for every qualified seller lead you produce

- $100 every time one of your leads becomes a closed deal



At target that is roughly $980/month. A strong month is over $1,150.



ALSO: paid weekly, every week, on time. 13th month pay. All tools and data provided.



WHO I WANT

- Near-native spoken English. You will be on the phone with Americans all day.

- At least 1 year of US real estate calling — cold calling, appointment setting, or inside sales for an investor, wholesaler or agent.

- You have used a real dialer (Mojo, ReadyMode, CallTools, BatchDialer, Xencall or similar).

- Backup internet AND backup power. Brownouts cannot cost me a calling day.

- Thick skin. People will hang up on you. The next dial has to sound just as good as the first.



WHO I DO NOT WANT

Anyone who has never called US homeowners. Anyone who needs a script read word for word and cannot think on a live call. Anyone who disappears for a day without telling me.



HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS CAREFULLY

Applications missing any of these go unread. This is the first test.



Start your reply with the word GULFCOAST.



Then send:

1. A 
 voice recording, 60 seconds, of exactly how you respond when a seller says "I'm not interested, stop calling me." Do not read a script. I want to hear you think.

2. How many years of US real estate calling, and for which company.

3. Which dialer you used, and one thing you liked or hated about it.

4. Your backup internet AND backup power setup.



I read every application that follows those four steps, and I reply to the ones I want to interview. Interviews are this week.



— Deion Johnson, Owner, Johnson Cornerstone Group LLC

title: Elite Real Estate CLOSER — $5/hr + Up To 15% Commission Every Deal
description:
Johnson Cornerstone Group LLC buys houses directly from owners on the Mississippi Gulf Coast — inherited properties, tax-delinquent owners, absentee landlords, tired rentals. I am the owner. You would work directly with me.



This is NOT a cold calling job. I have setters for that. This is the closer seat, and it is the most important hire I will make this year.



THE MONEY — YOU GET PAID EVERY SINGLE TIME YOU CLOSE

- $5.00/hour base, paid weekly

- PLUS commission on EVERY deal you close, on an escalating ladder:

  * Deals 1 and 2 in a month: 10% of the assignment fee

  * Deal 3: 12%

  * Deal 4 and beyond: 15%

- My assignment fees typically run around $10,000. That is roughly $1,000 to you on your first close of the month, and $1,500 each once you are rolling.

- Commission is paid the week my assignment funds. No waiting, no games, no clawbacks.

- 13th month pay.



Close three deals in a month and you out-earn nearly every office job in the Philippines. That is the entire point. I want someone who is hungry for the ladder, not comfortable on the base.



WHAT YOU ACTUALLY DO

A setter hands you a seller who is already qualified — condition, timeline, motivation and price expectation captured. You take it from there: build trust, handle the price objection, walk them through what a cash sale really nets them versus listing, and get the agreement signed. You are the last voice a seller hears before they sign.



YOU MUST ALREADY KNOW THE NUMBERS COLD

This is where most applicants fail and why I am being specific. You cannot close what you cannot calculate. You need to know, without looking it up:

- How to calculate Maximum Allowable Offer from ARV and repair cost

- The difference between ARV and as-is value, and why the seller's Zillow number is neither

- How to build a seller net sheet: agent commission, seller closing costs, repair cost, holding costs, and time on market

- What an assignment is and how to explain it to a seller in plain English without making them nervous

- What happens when there are back taxes, a lien, or multiple heirs on title — my book is full of estates and tax-delinquent owners, so this comes up constantly



DO NOT APPLY IF

You have only set appointments and never personally closed. You only did inbound or warm transfers. You need a script and freeze when the seller goes off it. You get uncomfortable talking about money. You cannot do the math above in your head on a live call.



HOW TO APPLY — FOUR PARTS, ALL REQUIRED

Applications missing any part go unread. I am measuring whether you follow instructions under pressure, because that is exactly the job.



Start your reply with the word COASTLINE.



1. THE MATH TEST. Show your work.

A house is worth $150,000 fully repaired. It needs $40,000 of work. I need a $10,000 assignment fee, and my cash buyers pay 70% of ARV minus repairs.

   a) What is the most I can pay this seller? Show the calculation.

   b) The seller says "I could list it and get $150,000." Build me their net sheet — what do they ACTUALLY walk away with after repairs, agent commission, closing costs, and four months of holding? Use real numbers.



2. THE LIVE OBJECTION. A 
 recording, 90 seconds. Same deal as above. The seller says: "That is way too low. I could get $150,000 for this house." Answer them out loud, exactly as you would on a live call. Do not read a script.



3. THE INTEGRITY QUESTION. Describe a situation where you would tell a seller NOT to sell to us, and to list with an agent instead. Be specific.



4. YOUR RECORD. How many deals have you personally closed, over what period, and for which company. Plus your backup internet AND backup power setup. I may ask to verify.



Question 1 and question 3 d
 this hire. If your math is right and your answer to 3 is honest, I want to talk to you today.



— Deion Johnson, Owner, Johnson Cornerstone Group LLC

The ideal candidate will be experienced in managing complex calendars, coordinating meetings and travel, preparing executive materials, and tracking priorities and action items through completion. This role requires excellent communication, strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to anticipate executive needs while handling confidential information with professionalism. The Executive Assistant will also support executive communications, reporting, document management, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. 



Key Responsibilities:



Executive Calendar, Meetings & Travel

* Manage complex executive calendars, recurring meetings, priorities, and scheduling conflicts across time zones.

* Prepare agendas, pre-reads, meeting materials, and weekly executive priority lists.

* Take or review meeting notes; document decisions, owners, deadlines, and unresolved follow-up items.

* Coordinate executive site and community visits, leadership meeting agendas, and travel itineraries; maintain executive travel preferences.

* Coordinate quarterly business review and board, owner, or investor materials when applicable.



Executive Follow-Through & Communications

* Track executive commitments, major initiatives, transitions, owner requests, and other time-sensitive priorities.

* Follow up with leaders on open action items and escalate overdue or at-risk matters appropriately.

* Draft, format, and proofread executive
s, announcements, thank-you notes, recognition notes, condolence notes, and other high-touch communications.

* Create concise executive summaries, dashboards, and status updates for leadership review.



Confidential Records & Executive Administration

* Maintain confidential executive files, sensitive correspondence, organizational charts, templates, and executive contact lists.

* Establish clear file-naming conventions and organize executive records for efficient retrieval.

* Route contracts and other documents for leadership review and signature, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality.

* Support policy, leadership roster, and organizational information updates assigned by the executive team.



Qualifications:

* Three or more years of experience supporting executives or senior leaders in a remote or fast-paced environment.

* Strong calendar, meeting, travel, document-management, and written communication experience.

* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace; experience with SharePoint, Teams, Zoom, and project-tracking tools is preferred.

* Demonstrated discretion when handling confidential, legal, personnel, or business information.

* Excellent written and spoken English; strong attention to detail and professional judgment.



Core Competencies:

* Executive presence and discretion.

* Exceptional organization, prioritization, and follow-through.

* Clear written communication and strong proofreading skills.

* Ability to anticipate needs, work independently, and manage shifting priorities.

* Comfort coordinating with leaders, owners, community teams, and external stakeholders.



Success Measures :

* Executive calendars and meeting materials are accurate and prepared on time.

* Action items and executive commitments are consistently tracked and followed through.

* Leaders receive timely visibility into overdue, high-risk, or unresolved matters.

* Confidential files and communications are organized, accurate, and appropriately protected.



Role Scope: This role coordinates, tracks, prepares, and escalates. Final legal, employment, financial, and operational decisions remain with authorized leadership. 



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Operations Assistant - Short Term Rental
description:

Spot-check cleaning photos and notes in Turno (roughly 2 in 3 turnovers per property, plus always the first clean after a new inventory item or guest complaint)

Escalate safety or guest-impacting issues (broken lock, no hot water, AC out) to Krista and the property owner same day

Log minor/cosmetic issues for the next inspection cycle, no owner escalation needed

4. Turno Property Setup

Build cleaning checklists per property, consistent with our existing standard

Organize and upload staging/reference photos so cleaners know the target standard for each room

5. Hostfully Guidebook

Keep guidebooks updated as property details change

6. New Property Launch Checklist

Use this checklist to launch new properties consistently as we scale

7. Vendor Contact List

Keep this updated so maintenance issues outside a scheduled inspection have a go-to contact ready

Monitor early performance and adjust settings/responses as needed once live

Strong written English for owner/vendor communication

Reliable overlap with US Eastern time for at least part of the week

Comfortable and knowledgeable using AI tools to work more efficiently

title: DTC VSL Video Editor — AI Animation Experience Required
description:
We’re looking for an experienced  DTC video editor to work with a growing UK ecommerce brand on ongoing vertical VSLs and paid social creative.



AI animation experience is mandatory.



Please do not apply unless you can show commercially polished examples of AI/mechanism-style animations used to explain how a product, problem or process works.



Think:



* Bacteria or odour inside fabric

* Microscopic or fibre-level visuals

* Skin or beauty mechanisms

* Inside-the-body health animations

* Product or scientific explainers



Experience with health, wellness, beauty, skincare, supplements or fitness brands is strongly preferred.



We are not looking for generic AI imagery. The animation needs to look good enough to run in a real DTC ad.



What you’ll do



Our main focus is vertical VSLs for Meta, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.



You’ll be expected to:



* Edit 1–2 VSLs per week

* Source relevant B-roll and stock footage

* Create AI-generated visuals and animations

* Turn scripts and briefs into strong visual sequences

* Create multiple hook variations

* Apply feedback quickly and accurately



We do not want to have to provide every individual asset or tell you what should appear on screen every few seconds.



Pace matters



You should naturally understand pacing, hooks and retention.



Our edits need to feel fast without becoming chaotic.



That means knowing when to tighten dialogue, remove pauses, speed up clips, change visuals, zoom in, introduce B-roll or animation, and keep the viewer engaged.



Every second of a paid-social ad needs to justify the viewer continuing to watch.



Strong English is important



We use AI voiceovers regularly, so you need strong English and a good ear for natural speech.



You should recognise when emphasis, pacing, pauses or intonation sound unnatural rather than simply generating a voiceover and dropping it onto the timeline.



Experience required



You must have experience editing vertical DTC/ecommerce ads.



We are not interested in editors whose portfolio is mainly long-form YouTube, podcasts, weddings or landscape content.



We care about the finished output, not which editing software you use.



Reliability



Once you have everything required for a project, we generally expect the first VSL edit within 2–3 working days.



If you regularly miss deadlines, disappear during projects or require constant chasing, this role will not be a good fit.



For someone who produces strong work reliably, there will be consistent weekly projects.



How to apply



Please send:



1. Your best AI mechanism animation example**

This is the most important part of your application. Please only send work you personally created or edited.



2. Your 3 best vertical DTC ads



3. Which AI tools you currently use



4. Your normal turnaround time



5. Your rate / preferred payment structure



Start your application with the word "MECHANISM” so we know you read the full post.



This is an ongoing part-time freelance role, with a target of at least one strong VSL per week and potentially 1–2 per week for the right person.

title: Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
Marketing Assistant / Digital Marketing Specialist

U.S.-Based Financial Advisory & Life Insurance Account | Remote | Night Shift — Philippines



Compensation: $7 USD/hour

Schedule: 5 hours/day, night shift (Philippine Time)

Location: Remote — Philippines

Experience Required: 1–2+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience



About the Role



We are looking for a highly capable, strategic, and creative Marketing Assistant to join our team and support the digital marketing efforts of a U.S.-based financial advisory and life insurance business.



This is not a basic social media posting role.



We are looking for someone who understands how to turn financial expertise into compelling content, build trust with high-value prospects, conduct meaningful market research, develop content strategies, and help position a financial advisory brand as a credible authority.



Our target audience includes high-income individuals, business owners, professionals, executives, families, and affluent clients who are interested in wealth protection, financial planning, life insurance, asset preservation, and long-term wealth strategies.



The financial advisor/owner does not want to appear on camera, so one of your biggest challenges — and opportunities — will be figuring out how to build a premium, trustworthy personal-finance brand without relying on the advisor's face or talking-head videos.



We want someone who can bring ideas to the table, not someone who simply waits to be told what to post.



What You'll Be Responsible For

1. Content Strategy & Planning

Develop and maintain a strategic monthly content calendar.

Research financial, wealth-management, life-insurance, and affluent-consumer topics.

Identify content opportunities based on market trends, audience pain points, questions, and competitors.

Develop content pillars that support brand awareness, authority, trust, and lead generation.

Turn complex financial concepts into content that is understandable, compelling, and appropriate for the target audience.

Recommend content formats across platforms, including short-form video, carousels, graphics, educational posts, articles, and other digital assets.

2. Financial & Market Research

Research topics relevant to financial advisors, life insurance, wealth protection, estate planning, business owners, and high-net-worth audiences.

Monitor competitors and identify successful content strategies.

Research audience behavior, trends, keywords, questions, and common objections.

Stay informed about relevant digital marketing trends and platform changes.

Turn research into actionable marketing recommendations.

3. Social Media & Brand Management

Help manage and grow the company's social media presence.

Create, schedule, organize, and publish content according to the approved content calendar.

Maintain consistent brand voice, visual identity, and messaging.

Track content performance and identify what is and isn't working.

Continuously improve content based on engagement and audience behavior.

4. Graphic Design

Create professional social media graphics, carousels, educational posts, presentations, and other marketing materials.

Maintain a polished, premium visual identity appropriate for a financial services brand targeting affluent clients.

Use tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or equivalent design platforms.

5. Video Editing & Content Production

Edit short-form videos, educational clips, motion graphics, screen-recorded content, stock-footage videos, and other faceless video formats.

Create engaging videos using voiceovers, captions, animations, charts, B-roll, graphics, and licensed stock footage.

Repurpose long-form ideas into multiple short-form content pieces.

Help develop a recognizable video style that does not require the advisor to appear on camera.

6. Portfolio & Marketing Asset Updates

Keep marketing portfolios, content libraries, campaign materials, and relevant digital assets organized and updated.

Maintain organized folders and content databases.

Track previously published content and identify opportunities for repurposing or updating evergreen material.

7. Marketing & Lead Generation Support

Assist in developing campaigns designed to attract qualified prospects.

Help create educational lead magnets and marketing assets.

Support landing-page,
, social-media, and other digital marketing initiatives.

Think beyond likes and followers — focus on building trust and generating qualified interest.

Help develop strategies that move a prospect from awareness ? education ? trust ? inquiry.

8. Reporting & Optimization

Monitor key content and marketing metrics.

Prepare simple performance reports and recommendations.

Identify high-performing topics and formats.

Test new approaches and continuously improve the marketing strategy.

Explain not only what happened, but why it happened and what we should do next.

Who We're Looking For



We want someone who is:



Strategic — you understand why content is being created, not just how to create it.

Creative — you can develop fresh ideas without relying on generic templates.

Research-driven — you know how to investigate an audience, market, competitor, and topic.

Independent — you can take ownership of projects without constant supervision.

Detail-oriented — especially important when working with financial and professional content.

Business-minded — you understand that marketing should ultimately contribute to business growth.

A strong communicator — you can explain your ideas clearly and professionally.

Comfortable with financial topics — you don't need to be a financial advisor, but you should be comfortable researching and learning financial concepts.

Results-oriented — you care about meaningful audience growth, qualified leads, trust, and conversion rather than vanity metrics alone.



Required Experience

1–2+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience

Experience creating and managing social media content

Experience with content strategy and research

Experience with graphic design

Experience with video editing

Familiarity with social media analytics and performance tracking

Strong written English

Ability to work independently

Ability to work a night shift aligned with U.S. business hours

Reliable internet connection and appropriate equipment for remote work

Strongly Preferred



Experience working with or marketing for:



Financial advisors

Life insurance professionals

Wealth management firms

Financial services companies

Insurance agencies

Personal brands targeting affluent or professional audiences



REQUIRED Before Applying to see if you've read through it!



Please do NOT simply send us your resume.



Before submitting your application, we want to see how you think.



You are responsible for marketing a U.S.-based financial advisory and life insurance business that primarily wants to attract high-income professionals, business owners, executives, and affluent families.



The advisor has extensive financial knowledge but does not want to appear on camera or show their face in marketing videos.



The company's goal is not simply to gain followers. The goal is to build credibility, attract the right audience, generate qualified conversations, and ultimately turn trust into business.



Your Challenge:



Specifically, tell us:



How would you make topics such as life insurance, wealth protection, and financial planning interesting enough that a high-income prospect would actually stop scrolling and pay attention?



How would you move someone from simply seeing our content to actually trusting the company enough to book a conversation?



Give us one specific campaign idea you would launch.



Don't just tell us, "I would create educational content about life insurance."



Show us the concept.



We are much more interested in your thinking, strategy, creativity, and ability to understand the target market than in a polished answer full of marketing buzzwords.



What Success Looks Like



Within this role, we want you to become someone who can look at the business and say:



"Here is who we're trying to reach.

Here is what they care about.

Here is what they're currently seeing online.

Here is the gap.

Here is the content strategy I recommend.

And here is how we're going to turn that attention into qualified opportunities."



You will have room to experiment, propose ideas, test strategies, and improve the company's digital presence.



If you need someone to give you every post idea, this probably isn't the right role.



If you enjoy researching, creating, testing, analyzing, and building marketing systems, we'd love to hear from you.



How to Apply



Please send:



Your resume/CV

A brief summary of your digital marketing experience

Links to relevant portfolios, social media accounts, campaigns, graphics, or videos you've created

Your experience working with financial, insurance, wealth-management, or other professional-service businesses, if applicable

Your answer to the Marketing Challenge above



Applications without an answer to the Marketing Challenge may not be considered.



Compensation & Schedule



Rate: $7 USD/hour

Hours: 5 hours per day

Schedule: Night shift, Philippine Time

Work Arrangement: Remote



We are looking for someone who can grow with the business and potentially take on greater responsibility as the marketing operation develops.

title: Short Form Video Editor for Ecommerce Ads (Meta, UGC, AI Video)
description:
About us



We are a small ecommerce brand in the health and supplement space. We sell to customers in the United States and Canada, and we run our advertising on
 and Instagram. The business is run by one person right now, so you will be working directly with the owner, not through a manager or an agency layer.



We are looking for an editor to build these ads for us on a project basis. Work comes in batches. Some months there are several, some months there are none. We are not offering fixed weekly hours, so please only apply if project work suits you.



When a batch goes well, we come back to the same editor for the next one. Most of our work ends up going to a small number of people we trust.



What the job is



You will build the short video ads we run on
 and Instagram. Each batch is 3 to 5 videos, 30 to 90 seconds long, vertical format.



For every batch you will receive a written brief. The brief gives you the script, the hook, the pacing, and notes on what visuals we want. Your job is to turn that brief into a finished ad.



Your work will include:



Editing raw creator footage into a finished ad with captions, pacing, and sound design

Finding your own clips when a brief does not come with footage. We will tell you exactly what to look for. You find it and choose well.

Building AI video ads. This includes AI UGC avatars, faceless voiceover videos, cartoon and animated styles, and AI generated B-roll.

Adding on screen text and captions that are timed correctly

Exporting in 9:16, plus 1:1 and 4:5 versions

Making new versions of ads that perform well, usually a new opening with the same body



Requirements



At least 1 year editing short form video.
, Instagram, or TikTok content.

Strong with CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or After Effects

Real experience with AI video and voice tools. For example ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Higgsfield, Veo, Runway, or similar. Tell us which ones you use and show us work you made with them.

Able to deliver a batch of 3 ads within 48 hours

Computer that can run your editing software smoothly, plus stable internet for uploading large video files

Good written English. You will be reading briefs and asking questions in writing.

Comfortable working from a written brief without needing a call for every task



What makes you a strong fit



You have edited ads for an ecommerce brand before and can name the brand

You understand that the first 3 seconds decide whether the ad works

You ask a question when something in the brief is unclear instead of guessing

You want to learn the marketing side, not just the editing side. Over time we want you to understand why the ads are built the way they are, so you can make more of the decisions yourself.



What working with us looks like



You work directly with the owner. No middle layer, no chasing approvals.

Briefs are written out properly, so you are not guessing what we want

Any tools or accounts you need for the work are provided

Feedback is specific and comes back quickly

Editors who deliver get first call on every batch after that, and more freedom over how the ads get built



How to apply



Please send an application that includes all of the following:



Start your message with the word "pretzel" so we know you read the whole posting.

Links to 2 or 3 short form ads you personally edited. Tell us what your role was on each one.

At least one example of something you made using AI video tools, and which tools you used.

The editing software you use and your computer specifications.

Your internet speed and your available working hours in Philippine time.



Applications without the word "pretzel" will not be read. Please do not send an application written by ChatGPT. We would rather hear from you in your own words.



Shortlisted applicants will get one small batch to start. Everyone gets the same brief so we can compare fairly.

title: Customer Service & Operations Coordinator – Australian Plumbing Company
description:
# Customer Service & Operations Coordinator – Australian Plumbing Company



**Full-time remote position | Philippines-based | Brisbane business hours | Long-term role**



Mitchell Plumbing & Gas is a growing plumbing and gas maintenance company based in Brisbane, Australia. We work with homeowners, tenants, property managers and commercial clients throughout South-East Queensland.



Our remote administration team is a central part of our business—not an outsourced back-office function. We are looking for an experienced Customer Service & Operations Coordinator who wants to become a trusted, long-term member of our team.



## This is not a basic data-entry VA role



Customers rarely follow a script.



You will need to listen carefully, ask intelligent follow-up questions, understand what the customer is trying to achieve, explain the next step naturally and make sensible decisions.



We provide training, procedures, templates and support, but we do not want someone who needs a script for every conversation or waits to be told what to do next.



## Your responsibilities



### Customer service and sales



* Answer and return inbound customer calls promptly.

* Speak confidently with homeowners, tenants, property managers and suppliers.

* Ask relevant questions to understand plumbing issues, urgency, property access and customer expectations.

* Explain our services, attendance fees, pricing processes and next steps clearly.

* Convert suitable enquiries into confirmed bookings without using pushy sales tactics.

* Handle pricing objections and difficult conversations calmly and professionally.

* Keep customers updated instead of waiting for them to chase us.

* Recognise genuine emergencies and know when an issue needs to be escalated.



### Scheduling and operations



* Create accurate jobs from phone calls,
s and property management work orders.

* Schedule and reschedule plumbers while considering urgency, location, skills, materials and customer availability.

* Confirm appointments, tenant access, keys, parking requirements and special site instructions.

* Convert approved quotes into jobs and ensure nothing is left unscheduled.

* Coordinate between customers, tenants, property managers, plumbers and suppliers.

* Follow up missing information, photographs, approvals, quote decisions and outstanding actions.

* Order materials, prepare purchase orders, check supplier availability and investigate suitable alternatives when required.

* Monitor incomplete jobs, unscheduled work, pending quotes and follow-ups until they are resolved.



### Job administration



* Use Ascora to create and maintain jobs, quotes, invoices, purchase orders and customer records.

* Review plumbers’ job reports and photographs for missing or unclear information.

* Prepare and send accurate quotes and invoices.

* Send customer review requests and follow up overdue accounts where required.

* Keep clear, factual notes so another team member can immediately understand what has happened.

* Communicate important updates through Slack without allowing requests to disappear in old conversations.



### Technology and AI



You will use systems including:



* Ascora job-management software

* Slack

* GHL and our phone/SMS systems

* Microsoft 365

* AI tools such as ChatGPT or Codex



Previous Ascora experience is helpful but not required. Experience with ServiceM8, Simpro, Fergus, Tradify or another CRM/job-management platform is highly regarded.



You must be able to learn unfamiliar software, troubleshoot basic problems and search for solutions independently.



We actively use AI to improve speed and quality. However, AI must support your judgement—not replace it. You will be expected to check facts, apply the correct business context and rewrite outputs naturally before anything is sent to a customer.



## What we are looking for



* At least three years of phone-based customer service, sales, scheduling or operations experience.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Confidence holding natural, unscripted conversations with Australian customers.

* Strong active-listening and questioning skills.

* The ability to explain pricing and ask confidently for a booking.

* Sound judgement and the ability to d
 what can be handled independently and what needs escalation.

* Strong attention to detail without losing sight of urgency or the customer’s needs.

* Evidence of taking ownership and following matters through to completion.

* Experience using CRM, scheduling, ticketing or job-management software.

* Comfortable receiving direct feedback and continuously improving.

* A reliable computer, professional headset, quiet workspace, stable internet and backup internet or power arrangements.

* Availability to work exclusively with our team during the agreed hours.



Experience in plumbing, HVAC, electrical, property management, construction or another Australian home-service business would be a major advantage.



## Our values



We expect every team member to demonstrate:



* Clear and proactive communication

* Pride in representing the company

* Integrity and ownership

* Care and respect for customers and teammates

* Teamwork, initiative and forward planning



## Hours and pay



* Monday to Friday

* 8:00 am to 5:00 pm Brisbane time

* PHP60,000 per month, or the agreed Upwork hourly equivalent

* Initial paid trial period

* Long-term position for the right person

* Ongoing training, feedback and opportunities to take on greater responsibility



## How to apply



Generic cover letters will not be shortlisted.



Please provide the following:



1. A 60–90 second audio introduction explaining why this particular position suits you. Please speak naturally rather than reading a prepared script.



2. Respond to this customer scenario in your audio:



“A customer says their toilet was blocked this morning. They used a plunger and the outside drain overflowed, but the toilet now appears to be flushing. They have also noticed possible leaking around pipework in their garage.”



Explain how you would respond to the customer, what questions you would ask and what you would do next.



3. Write the job note you would enter into our job-management system based on the scenario above.



4. Briefly describe a difficult, unscripted customer call you personally handled. What did you do and what was the outcome?



5. Give an example of software you had to learn independently and how you handled a problem when the system did not work as expected.



6. Explain how you currently use AI in your work and how you check its accuracy before using the output.



7. Confirm your availability during Brisbane hours, current internet speed, backup internet/power arrangements and expected pay.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a live, unprepared customer role-play and a paid practical assessment.



Please provide a 60–90 second voice recording responding naturally to this scenario. Do not read from a prepared script.



“A customer advises that their toilet was blocked this morning. They used a plunger and the outside drain overflowed, but the toilet now appears to be flushing. They have also noticed possible leaking around pipework in their garage.”



Explain what you would say to the customer, the questions you would ask and what you would do next. We are assessing your communication and problem-solving—not your plumbing knowledge.



Upload the audio file with your proposal or provide a public view-only link.



At the end of your proposal, please confirm:



You can work Monday to Friday, 8:00 am–5:00 pm Brisbane time

Whether you have another job or clients during these hours

Your required notice period

Your primary and backup internet arrangements

Your backup plan for power outages

Your expected monthly pay



Applications that do not include the voice recording and answers to all five questions will not be shortlisted.

title: DaVinci Resolve Editor — Aerial ,Brand AND Corporate Films | Long-Term Role, We Train You
description:
We are Solent Sky Services, a UK aerial film and video production company. We shoot

from the air and the ground for commercial clients, and we produce our own content

for social media. We are looking for one video editor to become our in-house editing

partner - long term, exclusively with us. 



This is not a per-project gig. We want to find the right person, train them properly

on our systems, and build the role around them. We start at around 20 hours a week and

move to full time as our volume grows. Where it goes from there is up to how far you

want to take it - our ambition is to support the right editor in building out a proper

post-production setup of their own, with us as the anchor client.



WHAT YOU WILL BE EDITING



- Client projects: brand films, corporate and case study pieces, property and

  construction, events. These need narrative drive, clean pacing and a professional

  finish.

- Our own social advertising: short-form, fast, stylish kinetic edits that stop the

  scroll on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube Shorts.



You will work with aerial and ground footage, often log/flat profiles that need

grading, and a mix of proxy and original media depending on the job.



THE WORKFLOW



- DaVinci Resolve, non-negotiable. We work collaboratively in Resolve, so you must be

  comfortable working inside a shared project structure rather than editing in

  isolation and sending files back.

- Proxy and original media workflows - generating proxies, relinking to originals,

  and understanding when to use which.

- Clean, disciplined project organisation. Named bins, labelled timelines, versioned

  cuts. If someone else opens your project, it should make sense immediately.

- Cloud transfer of media and outputs.



If you already work this way, great. If you know Resolve well but have not done

collaborative or proxy workflows before, we will train you. We would rather teach the

process to a good editor than hire a fast editor with bad habits.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- A genuinely good editor. Rhythm, timing, and an instinct for what to cut. We can

  teach software; we cannot teach taste.

- Someone who wants to keep learning. New tools, new techniques, new formats.

- Someone who watches what is working right now - trends, formats, sound design,

  what platforms are rewarding this month - and brings ideas to us rather than waiting

  to be told.

- Reliable and communicative. You hit deadlines, and if something is going to slip,

  you tell us early.

- Comfortable working with a UK-based team (GMT/BST). We are flexible on your hours,

  but there should be some overlap with the UK working day.

- Looking for one long-term client rather than juggling several. We will be asking

  for exclusivity as the hours build, and we will make it worth your while.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Full training on our systems, workflow and house style. You will not be dropped in

  and left to guess.

- Stable, predictable work with one client, not feast-and-famine freelancing.

- Genuine progression: hours, rate and responsibility all grow as you do.

- Support in building your own post-production capability over time.

- Interesting footage and diverse range of projects.



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- Fusion or After Effects for motion graphics and titles

- Colour grading with LUTs and node-based correction in Resolve

- Sound design and audio cleanup in Fairlight

- Experience with drone footage (DJI,, RED RAW, log profiles)

- Basic graphic design for thumbnails and social assets

- Subtitling and captioning



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A showreel or 2-3 links to work you edited yourself. Tell us exactly what you did

   on each - if you did not edit it, do not send it.

2. One example of a short-form social edit and one example of something longer and

   more narrative or corporate. If you only have one of those, send what you have and

   say so.

3. A short note on your DaVinci Resolve experience: how long, what version, whether

   you have used collaborative projects or proxy workflows.

4. Your internet speed (a screenshot of a speed test), your computer specs, and your

   available hours per week in your local time.

5. Start your message with the word RESOLVE so we know you read this properly.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a short PAID test edit using our own footage.



We do not ask anyone to work for free.

I run several online businesses under one umbrella (Trend eMarketing Group) that are built, or nearly built, but stuck on technical execution. I'm not technical myself — I need someone who is, and who takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions.
