title: Real Estate Cold Caller / ISA  Part-Time Remote | 20 Hours/Week | Long-Term Opportunity
description:
I am a New Jersey REALTOR® building a dedicated seller-prospecting system and am looking for an experienced Real Estate Cold Caller / Inside Sales Agent (ISA) to join my business long-term.



This is NOT a general virtual assistant position.



Your primary responsibility will be outbound prospecting to homeowners, having quality conversations, identifying potential sellers, following up with prospects, and scheduling qualified seller appointments directly with me.



What You Will Do



You will:



* Make outbound calls to homeowners using BatchDialer

* Work with seller lists generated through PropStream

* Prospect absentee owners, high-equity homeowners, expired listings, FSBOs, tired landlords, and other potential sellers

* Follow provided cold-calling scripts

* Have natural conversations rather than simply reading from a script

* Identify homeowners who may be considering selling

* Ask qualifying questions about motivation, timeline, property condition, price expectations, and decision-makers

* Schedule qualified seller appointments

* Follow up with warm and nurture leads

* Enter detailed notes into our CRM

* Properly disposition every call

* Maintain accurate Do-Not-Call and opt-out records

* Provide daily activity reports

* Participate in weekly performance/coaching reviews

Experience I Am Looking For



Previous experience with U.S. real estate cold calling is strongly preferred.



Experience with any of the following is especially valuable:



* BatchDialer

* PropStream

* Real estate CRMs

* Expired listings

* FSBO leads

* Absentee owners

* Tired landlords

* High-equity homeowners

* Seller lead generation

* Appointment setting

* Real estate investor prospecting



If you have used other real-estate dialers or lead-generation platforms, please tell me which ones.



You Must Have



* Excellent spoken English

* Clear and professional telephone voice

* Confidence speaking with U.S. homeowners

* Strong communication skills

* Ability to handle rejection professionally

* Experience overcoming common cold-call objections

* Ability to sound conversational instead of robotic

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Reliable computer

* Quality headset

* Quiet working environment

* Ability to work during U.S. Eastern Time calling hours

* Strong organizational and follow-up skills

* Ability to follow scripts, procedures, and compliance requirements

Approximately 20 hours per week to start.



PLUS PERFORMANCE BONUSES:



$25 for each qualified seller appointment that is actually held.



$150 for each transaction that successfully closes from a lead you originally generated.



There is significant opportunity for increased hours and responsibility based on performance.



What Is a Qualified Seller Lead?



I am NOT looking for someone who labels every homeowner who says “maybe someday” as a lead.



A qualified opportunity should include information such as:



Motivation: Why is the homeowner considering selling?



Timeline: When would they realistically sell?



Property: What is the property’s current situation/condition?



Price: What are they expecting for the property?



Decision Makers: Who needs to be involved in the decision?



Next Step: Is the homeowner willing to speak or meet with the REALTOR®?



Quality is more important than simply producing a large number of “leads.”



Performance Will Be Measured



We will track:



* Hours worked

* Dial attempts

* Contacts

* Meaningful homeowner conversations

* Qualified seller opportunities

* Follow-ups generated

* Appointments scheduled

* Appointments held

* Listings signed

* Transactions closed



Call recordings may be reviewed for training, quality assurance, and coaching in accordance with applicable requirements.



Schedule



Approximately 20 hours per week, Monday–Friday.



You must be available during appropriate U.S. Eastern Time calling hours.



Specific calling blocks will be established after hiring.



This position may increase to 30–40 hours/week based on performance.



HOW TO APPLY



Please follow these instructions carefully.



At the VERY TOP of your application, write:



COMPASSION, COMMITMENT, KEYS



Applications that do not include these words at the beginning may not be reviewed.



Then answer ALL of the following:



1. How many years/months of U.S. real estate cold-calling experience do you have?

2. What types of real estate leads have you called?

3. Have you used BatchDialer? If yes, describe your experience.

4. Have you used PropStream? If yes, describe your experience.

5. What other dialers have you used?

6. What CRMs have you worked with?

7. Approximately how many dialing attempts can you complete during a 4-hour calling shift?

8. Approximately how many meaningful conversations and appointments did you typically generate in your previous role?

9. How do you respond when a homeowner says:

    “I’m not interested. Realtors call me every day.”

10. What do you consider a qualified seller lead?

11. What is your availability in U.S. Eastern Time?

12. What is your internet speed?

13. Please provide your computer specifications.

14. Why did you leave your most recent real estate cold-calling position?

15. Please provide contact information for at least one previous real estate employer/client who can verify your experience, if available.



VOICE RECORDING REQUIRED



Please submit a 60–90 second voice recording.



For your recording, pretend you are calling this homeowner:



John owns an investment property in New Jersey. He has owned it for 12 years and does not live at the property.



Pretend John just answered the telephone.



Give me your opening and demonstrate how you would begin the conversation to determine whether John has considered selling.



Do NOT send me a recording simply reading your résumé.



I want to hear how you would actually sound speaking with one of my potential clients.



Paid Trial



Final candidates may be invited to complete a short paid trial before a permanent hiring decision is made.



During the trial, I will evaluate:



* Communication

* Professionalism

* Confidence

* Ability to build rapport

* Objection handling

* Listening skills

* Lead qualification

* CRM/data accuracy

* Ability to follow instructions



About This Opportunity



I am looking for someone who wants to become part of a growing real estate business — not someone simply looking to make calls for a few weeks.



The right person will understand that the goal is not just to make hundreds of calls.



The goal is to create quality conversations and real relationships with homeowners that eventually become appointments, listings, referrals, and closed transactions.



If you are coachable, consistent, competitive, professional, and experienced in U.S. real estate prospecting, I would love to hear from you.

 & Instagram advertising

Building and managing Meta ad campaigns focused on appointment bookings and quality leads — not add-to-carts, not vanity metrics

Building and managing Google Ads — Search and Performance Max around high-intent terms like engagement rings, custom rings, local jeweller searches

Editing ad creative from the client's own photos and video — showroom footage, workshop and bench footage, real customers, real pieces

Klaviyo — lead nurture flows, appointment reminders, post-enquiry follow-ups, abandoned enquiry sequences, monthly campaigns

Building and editing websites and landing pages built around one goal: booking an appointment

Tracking setup and troubleshooting — Meta Pixel, Conversions API, GA4, Google Tag Manager, booking form and phone-call tracking

Weekly reporting per client — bookings, cost per booked appointment, what's working, what you're changing



On creative — read this before applying:

We do not use AI-generated images or AI video. Ever. Our clients sell real jewellery that people spend thousands on, and AI slop kills trust instantly. Every creative you make must be built from real assets the client gives us — their photography, their video, their store, their pieces. If your portfolio is Midjourney images and AI avatars, this role is not for you.



You must have:



2+ years hands-on managing Meta Ads and Google Ads (tell us the biggest monthly ad spend you've personally managed)

Real Klaviyo experience — you've built flows from scratch, not just hit send on a campaign

Strong editing skills in Canva, CapCut, Premiere or similar, working with real footage

A genuine eye for premium, tasteful design. Jewellery brands cannot look cheap

Excellent written English — you'll be writing ad copy and
s for Irish and UK customers

Ability to work independently. We give you the brief and the assets, you come back with it done

Reliable internet and a computer that handles video editing



Nice to have:



Experience with jewellery, luxury, or any high-ticket appointment-based business

Shopify experience

Agency experience juggling multiple clients

Basic HTML/CSS



The details:



Full time, Monday to Friday

Some overlap with Irish time (GMT/IST) required for calls and quick turnarounds

Long-term role with room to grow as we take on more jewellers



How to apply — read carefully:

Start your application with the word "GREENLIGHT" so we know you've read this properly. Applications without it will be deleted.



Then send:



2–3 ad creatives you personally edited from real client footage — tell us what you were given and what you made from it

One Klaviyo flow you built, and what it did for the client

One ad account you managed — client type, monthly spend, and the actual result

Any websites or landing pages you've built

Your expected monthly salary in USD



We're hiring one person and we'd rather wait for the right one. If this is you, we want to hear from you.



One last thing



If you make it to a video interview, wear black. No reminder will be sent. Our clients are jewellers — presentation and attention to detail are the job, and this is the first small test of both.

The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of residential property management, excellent communication and organisational skills, and ideally previous experience working with an Australian real estate agency.

* Providing excellent customer service to both landlords and tenants

## Requirements



To be considered for this position, you should have:



* **Minimum 2 years of property management experience**

* Strong knowledge of residential property management processes

* Good understanding of **NSW property management requirements and residential tenancy regulations**

* Previous experience working with an Australian real estate agency is highly preferred

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Excellent organisational and time-management skills

* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities independently

* A responsible, reliable and proactive attitude

* Strong problem-solving skills

* Confidence communicating with landlords, tenants and contractors

* Ability to work independently while being part of a remote team

* Good computer skills and ability to learn property management software quickly



Experience with Australian property management systems such as **PropertyMe, Property Tree, Console Cloud or similar platforms** will be highly regarded.



## Working Hours



This is a **full-time position of 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday**.



Working hours will be aligned with the Australian business day and the requirements of our NSW property management team.



Applicants must be comfortable working according to Australian business hours.



## Benefits



We are looking for someone who wants to build a stable, long-term career with our business.



Benefits include:



* Permanent full-time remote work

* Work from home in the Philippines

* 40-hour working week, Monday to Friday

* **Australian public holidays observed**

* Additional payment for approved overtime work

* Stable, long-term employment opportunity

* Opportunity to work directly with an Australian real estate agency

* Professional development and ongoing training

* Supportive team environment

* Opportunity to grow within our property management department



## The Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is not simply completing administrative tasks, but who genuinely takes ownership of their work.



The ideal candidate is:



* Responsible and dependable

* Detail-oriented

* Proactive rather than reactive

* Comfortable following up outstanding matters

* Able to communicate professionally with clients and tenants

* Capable of prioritising urgent matters

* Calm when dealing with difficult situations

* Willing to learn and improve

* Interested in building a long-term career in Australian property management



## How to Apply



Please submit your **CV/resume** together with a short introduction covering:



1. Your previous property management experience

2. How many years you have worked in property management

3. Whether you have previously worked for an Australian real estate agency

4. Your experience with NSW residential property management

5. Property management software you have used

6. Your current location in the Philippines

7. Your expected monthly salary

8. Your availability to commence



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to attend an online interview and complete a short property management knowledge assessment.



**Join IC Realty and become part of a growing Australian property management team where reliability, professionalism and excellent client service are highly valued.**

title: GoHighLevel Systems Specialist — Complete Existing Build
description:
TintGard is an Australian window tinting company specialising in automotive, residential and commercial window tinting. We are looking for an experienced GoHighLevel specialist to take over and complete an existing GHL build and bring it to production-ready launch within 2 weeks. A significant amount of the system has already been built. We are not looking for a complete rebuild from scratch. The successful specialist will review what currently exists, retain what is working correctly, fix or improve what is required, and complete the remaining system. This is not a basic GHL setup or VA role. We are looking for someone who has personally built and launched sophisticated GHL systems for service businesses.



The objective

Complete TintGard OS so it manages the customer lifecycle across our three divisions:

Automotive | Residential | Commercial/Office

The overall journey covers:

Lead capture - qualification/nurturing - quote or online purchase - booking - job completion - aftercare - customer experience - reviews - referrals - reactivation - lifetime customer



- GoHighLevel is our CRM, sales, marketing, AI and customer lifecycle platform.

- ServiceM8 remains our operational platform for quotes, work orders, scheduling, jobs, invoicing and payments.



Key technical requirements

You need proven capability in:

* Advanced GoHighLevel customer lifecycle automation

* Taking over, auditing and completing an existing GHL build

* GHL, ServiceM8 or comparable job-management integrations

* APIs, webhooks and 
/Zapier/n8n

* GHL Conversational AI / AI Agents

* Website and GHL integration

* Landing pages and funnels

* Online/instant quoting pathways

* Online shopping, checkout and payment pathways

* Forms, surveys and customer experience journeys

* Multi-channel lead capture and communication

* CRM/database architecture and segmentation

* Quote follow-up, objection handling and sales recovery automation

* Review, referral and reactivation systems

* Large historical customer database import/segmentation

* Reporting and management dashboards

* Error monitoring, exception handling and failed-integration alerts

* End-to-end testing and production deployment



One particularly important requirement is system reliability. We need someone who understands how to identify and protect against workflows, webhooks and integrations failing silently. The finished system must be built specifically around TintGard's operating processes, not simply be a generic GHL snapshot. 



Existing build

You will be taking over an existing partial implementation.

Your job is to:

Understand it - validate it - retain what works - fix what doesn't - complete what is missing - test the entire customer lifecycle - launch it.

Existing documentation and the detailed TintGard OS scope will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

Project terms



Fixed project: A$500

Completion: 2 weeks



Please only apply if you have the technical experience and availability to deliver within these terms. To apply

1. Examples of complete GHL systems you have personally built and launched.

2. A Loom/video walkthrough of a GHL system you personally implemented.

3. Your experience with service/trades/automotive businesses.

4. Your experience integrating GHL with ServiceM8 or similar job-management platforms.

5. Your experience with APIs/webhooks and 
, Zapier or n8n.

6. Your experience with GHL AI/Conversational AI.

7. Your experience with funnels, online quoting and online purchasing/e-commerce.

8. Your experience with database reactivation and large contact databases.

9. Briefly explain how you test integrations and detect automation failures before and after launch.

10. Only apply if you can commence promptly and complete the project within 2 weeks for the fixed A$500 project price.

Monitor stock levels and flag when reorders are needed before we run out.

Respond to buyer chat messages and handle basic order/return queries.

Keep an eye on ad campaign performance (Shopee GMV Max / Lazada Sponsored Max) and flag anything unusual — we'll set the targets.



Weekly listing targets: 8–10 completed listings/week for the first 2 weeks while we clear the current backlog, then 3–5/week afterward as the role shifts more toward day-to-day shop management. Targets account for the fact that listings are only part of the role, not the whole job.



What we're looking for: prior experience with Shopee/Lazada Seller Center (must), comfort learning AI content tools, strong written English for buyer chat, and someone organized enough to track inventory without being chased. Candidates with an artistic or design background (e.g. graphic design, photo/video editing, Canva or Affinity proficiency) will have an advantage, since the role includes shop decoration and content styling.



To apply: along with your application, please attach one sample of your design work — this can be a shop banner mockup, an edited product photo, or a short video you've created.



Selection process: shortlisted applicants will be given a short paid test task, followed by a final paid trial round for top candidates, before starting the full 3-month engagement.



All required tools and software (AI content generation, Canva/Affinity, inventory tracking, seller center access) will be provided — no need to purchase anything yourself.



Payment terms: during the 3-month engagement, paid weekly based on completed work and agreed targets, rather than a lump sum. If weekly targets are consistently not met, we reserve the right to end the engagement before the 3-month mark. Candidates who perform well and hit targets will be considered for a permanent role after the trial period.

title: Short-Form Video Editor + Creative Assistant
description:
I'm the founder of ICHOR Performance, a new premium performance brand being built around training, athletics, adventure, and high-performance lifestyle.



We're preparing for launch, and I'm looking for one creative person to grow with the brand long-term.



This is not a generic virtual assistant position.



Your main responsibility will be taking raw footage from me, including founder videos, gym footage, training, business building, lifestyle clips, and product development, and turning it into polished short-form content for Instagram Reels and TikTok.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Edit approximately 3 to 5 short-form videos per week.



Turn raw talking-head footage into compelling 20 to 60 second stories.



Identify strong hooks and moments without needing exact instructions.



Color correct and grade footage.



Clean and improve audio.



Add captions, music, sound design, B-roll, and tasteful graphics.



Create premium fitness and lifestyle edits.



Help brainstorm content ideas and hooks.



Study successful fitness, lifestyle, founder, and performance brands.



Help develop a recognizable visual style for ICHOR.



Organize completed content and raw footage.



THE STYLE



I'm not looking for overly edited videos filled with emojis, crazy transitions, constant zooms, or giant captions.



The ICHOR aesthetic should feel premium, athletic, cinematic, modern, dark, energetic, and aspirational.



The content should make a young startup feel like a much larger brand.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



You genuinely understand TikTok and Reels pacing.



You have excellent visual taste.



You understand fitness and lifestyle content.



You can take messy raw footage and find the story inside it.



You don't need every cut explained to you.



You're willing to suggest better ideas when you see them.



You're reliable and communicate well.



You want a long-term role rather than random freelance projects.



Experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut Desktop is fine.



Your portfolio matters much more to me than your resume.



COMPENSATION



$400 USD per month to start.



Approximately 12 to 15 flexible hours per week.



This is intended to become a long-term position. As ICHOR grows and you prove yourself, there will be opportunities for increased compensation, responsibility, and potentially a larger creative role within the brand.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word ASCEND.



Please send links to the three short-form videos you're most proud of editing.



Tell me which two or three creators or brands you think currently make excellent fitness, lifestyle, or founder content.



Tell me whether you're comfortable receiving around 10 minutes of unscripted raw footage and independently finding the strongest 30 to 60 second story inside it.



Tell me what editing software you primarily use.



Finally, based on the description of ICHOR above, give me one short-form content idea you think the brand should make.



Please do not send a long generic cover letter.



I'm primarily evaluating taste, creativity, storytelling, and whether you actually read this posting.



Strong applicants may be invited to complete a paid editing audition using the same raw footage as the other finalists.

title: Organic Growth Marketer & Video Editor
description:
Type: Full-time or part-time (based on your availability) | 100% remote | US EST hours



About us



Appeals Dr is a fast-growing, Florida-based company that helps Amazon sellers resolve account issues, protect their stores, and scale. We are an Amazon SPN partner with a 93% appeal success rate and $17.8M recovered for sellers. We invest heavily in training, professional growth, and a positive remote culture.



The role



Build and run our organic content engine. You are our internal "Company Detective": you dig through recorded sales calls, Slack, and Salesforce to find real customer wins, turn them into daily short-form content, prep a weekly topic brief for our CEO, and direct his one-hour filming block. You own the process from finding the story to posting the edited video.



You will not start from a blank page. You work from AI-assisted briefs and our content system, so your edge here is execution, judgment, and consistency, not inventing everything alone.



What you'll do



* Publish daily across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn,
, and YouTube Shorts, plus one long-form YouTube video each week. On time, every day.

* Mine for gold: dig through calls, Slack, and the CRM for real wins and quotes, and spot the story others miss.

* Direct the CEO: turn ideas into simple scripts and confidently run his weekly one-hour filming block.

* Edit and write: cut short-form video and write sharp hooks, captions, and posts.

* Build the systems: content calendars and workflows that keep publishing consistent without bottlenecks.

* Keep the proof vault: a tagged Google Drive of clips, case studies, and testimonials so sales can grab a win instantly.

* Engage and escalate: reply to comments and DMs, share content in relevant groups, and flag hot leads to sales the same day.

* Protect the brand: anonymize all client details (store names, IDs, faces) before anything is posted, and never promise guaranteed outcomes. Use only approved stats.

* Track and adjust: monitor views, retention, and engagement, and change your approach based on the numbers.

* Learn the industry: get fluent in Amazon Seller Central and seller pain points. We will train you.



You're a fit if you..



* Are relentlessly consistent. This is the number one requirement. The engine depends on daily posting never slipping.

* Have an editorial eye: you can watch a long video and instantly know the clip.

* Are AI-forward: you use AI tools every day to work faster and write better.

* Can edit and design: hands-on with CapCut or Premiere Pro, and Canva.

* Write sharp copy: hooks, posts, and scripts that get people to act.

* Write and speak fluent, natural English.

* Are comfortable in Slack, Google Drive, and a CRM (Salesforce a plus).

* * Bonus: you have grown an organic audience before.



Mindset



Extreme ownership (you figure things out without hand-holding). Unintimidated (comfortable directing the CEO on camera and keeping him on schedule). Curious about the technical side of Amazon. Genuinely data-driven.



What success looks like (first 90 days)



* 100% on-time daily posting across all channels.

* The CEO gets a full topic brief before every filming session, so he never has to brainstorm.

* An organized, tagged proof vault the sales team actually uses.

* Month-over-month growth in engagement, video retention, and inbound leads.



Compensation and growth



* Monthly salary or hourly rate based on your experience and hours.

* Performance bonuses tied directly to the results you generate.

* A paid budget for approved courses and books, plus direct mentorship.

* A fast-paced, results-driven team that rewards initiative.



How to apply (please follow all steps)



1. Show us what you can do. Send a 1-minute Loom or Google Drive video on why you are a fit for this role, along with your resume, video portfolio, and copywriting samples.

2. Paid challenge. If your application stands out, we send you a short paid task that mirrors the real work.

3. Interview. Nail the challenge and we invite you to meet the team and align on your first 90 days.



Applications without the 1-minute video and samples will not be reviewed.

• Company: Ngaio Diagnostics (NgaioDx)

• Employment Type: Full-Time (Remote)

• Compensation: Base Salary + Sales Bonus Recognising Performance

About NgaioDx:

Ngaio Diagnostics (NgaioDx) is a trusted partner and leading supplier of high-quality diagnostic solutions, laboratory reagents, life science equipment, consumables, and analytical technologies. We serve clients across diverse sectors, including:

• Clinical Diagnostic Laboratories

• Food Safety & Quality Assurance

• Animal Health & Veterinary Diagnostics

• Environmental & Water Testing

• Academic & Government Research Institutes

• Industrial & Applied Diagnostics



We are seeking a highly motivated, scientifically grounded, and proactive Technical Sales Specialist to spearhead our commercial expansion into overseas territories within the Pacific region.

This role will also support the maintenance of our domestic product catalogues hosted online at major NZ customers.



The Role & Opportunity:

This is a growth and business development role, with some data maintenance. You will not be managing an existing account portfolio; instead, you will be tasked with mapping the territory, identifying opportunities, and building our customer base completely from scratch across all industry verticals in the designated island nations and territories of the Pacific.



Key Responsibilities:

• Territory Mapping & Prospecting: Identify and build a pipeline of target B2B and B2G accounts across hospital labs, commercial reference laboratories, food/beverage quality control facilities, agricultural/veterinary clients, and environmental agencies.

• Consultative Technical Selling: Engage with key decision-makers (Laboratory Managers, Chief Pathologists, QC Directors, Procurement Officers, and Lead Scientists) to understand their specific assay, diagnostic, and workflow requirements.

• Solution Matching & Quotations: Present and match NgaioDx’s comprehensive product portfolio to customer specifications. Prepare technical quotations, tender submissions, and product proposals.

• End-to-End Sales Execution: Manage the complete sales cycle from initial cold outreach and discovery meetings to closing contracts and facilitating delivery setup.

• Account Cultivation: Build long-term, high-trust relationships with new customers to foster repeat orders, brand loyalty, and recurring revenue.

Mandatory Qualifications & Requirements:

PLEASE NOTE: Applications without verified scientific credentials will not be considered.

1. Academic & Professional Qualifications (Strict Requirement):

o Certified Medical Laboratory Scientist (MLS / BMLS), OR

o Advanced Academic Qualification: PhD in a scientific discipline (e.g., Microbiology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Clinical Chemistry, Pathology, or related Life Sciences).

2. Deep Scientific & Technical Mastery:

o In-depth understanding of standard and advanced laboratory techniques (e.g., PCR/qPCR, ELISA, automated chemistry analyzers, rapid diagnostic testing, microbiology culture, chromatography, sample preparation, and laboratory QA/QC standards).

o Ability to hold high-level, peer-to-peer technical discussions with senior laboratory personnel.

3. Sales Drive & BD Mindset:

o Natural commercial instinct with a passion for prospecting, overcoming objections, and closing sales. Prior technical sales or account management experience in diagnostics, medtech, or scientific equipment is preferred but not required if strong commercial drive is demonstrated.

4. Communication & Remote Setup:

o Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

o High-speed internet, dedicated home office setup.

What We Offer:

• Stable Base Salary: Reliable base compensation.

• Performance Recognition Bonus Structure: Generous, bonus scheme directly tied to target achievement, deal closing, and revenue growth in your assigned territory.

• Professional Impact: Represent a respected brand providing essential diagnostic and scientific equipment to growing regions.

How to Apply:

If you meet the scientific requirements and are excited to build a successful overseas sales territory from the ground up:

1. Click Apply Now.

2. Submit your Updated CV.

3. Include a Cover Letter explicitly detailing:

o Your scientific qualifications (PhD field or MLS certification).

o Your experience with laboratory techniques and diagnostics.

o Why you are confident in your ability to build a sales territory from scratch.

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor — B2B & B2C Performance Ads



Full-Time / Long-Term Position



We’re looking for a high-quality Video Editor to join our team and handle video editing across both our client accounts and our own agency.



The majority of the work will be short-form performance advertising designed for Meta platforms, so we're looking for someone who understands how to make ads that are clean and professional while still being engaging enough to stop the scroll.



What You'll Be Editing



You'll work across two main areas:



B2C / Home Service Advertising



* Window replacement

* Roofing

* Siding & exteriors

* Painting

* Remodeling

* Other high-ticket home services



B2B / Agency Advertising



* Ads promoting our own agency

* Case study videos

* Testimonials

* VSL-style content

* Founder-led ads

* Educational and authority content

* Short-form social content



You'll be given raw footage, scripts, creative direction, and examples depending on the project. We need someone who can take those assets and turn them into a finished, polished ad without needing to be micromanaged through every cut.



What We're Looking For



You need to be strong at:



* Short-form video editing

* Direct-response / performance ad editing

* Clean, easy-to-read captions

* Motion graphics

* Text animations and callouts

* B-roll selection and placement

* Sound design

* Music selection

* Pacing and retention

* Strong hooks in the first few seconds

* Smooth transitions where appropriate

* Basic color correction and audio cleanup

* Turning raw talking-head footage into engaging ads

* Following brand guidelines while still bringing your own creative ideas



We're not looking for someone who throws captions onto a video, adds a few transitions, and calls it finished.



We want an editor who understands that every cut, caption, piece of B-roll, graphic, sound effect, and visual change should help keep attention and communicate the message.



Motion Graphics



You don't need to be a Hollywood-level motion designer, but you should be comfortable creating things such as:



* Animated headlines

* Price/offer graphics

* Reviews and testimonial overlays

* Before-and-after sequences

* Maps and location callouts

* Statistics and numbers

* Product/service callouts

* Simple charts and visual explanations

* Branded lower thirds

* CTA animations

* Social proof elements



Experience with After Effects or similar motion graphics software is a major advantage.



English — VERY IMPORTANT



You must have very strong written and spoken English.



You'll regularly be editing English-speaking creators, business owners, salespeople, and advertisements.



You need to understand:



* What the speaker is actually saying

* Where sentences should be cut

* Which words should be emphasized

* Correct spelling and grammar for captions

* American/UK expressions and terminology

* The overall message and intent behind an advertisement



If you cannot confidently understand fast conversational English, this position probably isn't the right fit.



The Type of Editor We Want



We want someone who can receive a raw video and think creatively rather than just follow instructions mechanically.



For example, if someone says:



"Most window companies are charging homeowners $2,000+ per window..."



You should already be thinking about how you could visually reinforce that statement — price graphics, competitor imagery, B-roll, motion graphics, punch-ins, captions, sound design, etc.



We're looking for someone who asks:



"How can I make this part hit harder?"



Not just:



"Where should I make the next cut?"



Requirements



* Proven video editing experience

* Strong portfolio of previous work

* Excellent English

* Experience editing short-form content

* Comfortable working with deadlines

* Good communication

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to take feedback and implement it quickly

* Reliable and consistent

* Able to work across multiple brands and visual styles

* Comfortable working as part of a fast-moving team



Experience with direct-response ads, Meta/Facebook advertising, home services, agencies, or performance marketing is highly preferred.



When Applying



Please send examples of your best work.



We specifically want to see examples that demonstrate:



1. Short-form advertisements

2. Talking-head editing

3. Motion graphics

4. Captions/text animation

5. B2C advertising

6. B2B advertising



Home-service advertising examples are a big plus.



Please don't send us a folder containing 50 random videos.



Send us 3–5 of your strongest examples that best represent what you're capable of.



Along with your portfolio, tell us:



* What editing software you primarily use

* How many years you've been editing

* Whether you've edited paid social ads before

* Whether you've worked with agencies before

* Your current availability

* Your expected monthly compensation

* Your English proficiency



About the Role



This is intended to be a long-term position, not a one-off editing project.



There will be consistent creative volume across both our client accounts and our own company, and we're looking for someone who can become a core part of the creative team as we grow.



If you're a strong editor who understands performance marketing, attention, pacing, storytelling, and clean visual execution, we'd like to see your work.



Apply with your portfolio and 3–5 examples of your strongest edits.

Part-Time Social Media Content Creator & Planner – Vacation Rentals



We are an established vacation rental company in Muskegon, Michigan, USA, looking for a creative, dependable and proactive Social Media Content Creator & Planner to help us consistently market our vacation rental properties and our destination.



This is a part-time, long-term opportunity for the right person.



What We Are Looking For



We are not looking for someone who simply waits for us to tell them what to post each week.



We are looking for someone who enjoys coming up with ideas.



We will provide you with photos, videos, property information, guest reviews, availability information and updates about our vacation rentals.



Your job is to take those raw materials and turn them into engaging, attractive content for
 and Instagram.



We want someone who can look at the content we provide and decide:



What story can we tell with this?

Should this be a Reel, carousel, Story or regular post?

What would make a traveler stop scrolling?

What caption and call to action would work?

Is there an upcoming holiday, season, event or travel opportunity we should be talking about?

How can this content help more people discover our vacation rentals and our destination?

We Want Someone Who Thinks Beyond the Property



Our homes are located near beautiful Lake Michigan, but we understand that people travel for many different reasons throughout the year.



They may be coming for a family vacation, a long weekend, sporting event, wedding, holiday gathering, festival, family visit or simply a getaway.



We want someone who is curious enough to learn about our area and think creatively about why someone might want or need to visit during every season of the year.



We also want to grow beyond our local audience.



Part of our long-term goal is to use social media to introduce our destination and vacation rentals to potential travelers in other cities and states who may not currently know about us.

Create Instagram and
 Reels using our photos and video clips

Create carousel posts, regular posts and occasional graphics

Create Instagram/Facebook Story content

Write natural, engaging English-language captions and calls to action

Select the best photos and videos from the content we provide

Maintain a simple monthly content calendar

Think ahead about holidays, seasons, events and travel opportunities

Develop content about our destination as well as our individual properties

Incorporate guest reviews and property highlights

Help us creatively promote last-minute availability when appropriate

Bring us your own ideas instead of always waiting for instructions

Prepare everything so the owner can quickly review it and publish it

Important: You Will NOT Manage Our Social Media Accounts



You will not need our
 or Instagram passwords.



You will not be responsible for publishing the content.



The owner will retain control of the accounts and will publish the finished content.



Your responsibility is to plan and create the content and make it extremely easy for us to post.



Skills We Are Looking For



You should be comfortable with:



Instagram and

Canva

Reels and short-form video editing

Writing engaging English-language captions

Social media content planning

Creating attractive travel, hospitality and lifestyle content

Researching destinations, events and seasonal content opportunities



Experience with vacation rentals, Airbnb, Vrbo, hospitality, tourism, destination marketing or real estate is a plus.



The Person We Are Looking For



You are:



Creative and full of ideas

Dependable

Organized

Comfortable working independently

A good communicator

Able to meet deadlines

Curious and willing to research

Someone who notices marketing opportunities

Someone who enjoys visual storytelling

Someone who understands that social media should create interest, engagement and ultimately help grow a business



Most importantly, we want someone who will eventually understand our company and our style well enough to say:



“I have an idea for something we should post.”



rather than always asking:



“What would you like me to post?”



How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself.

Your experience creating
 and Instagram content.

Links or examples of Reels, graphics, posts or social media accounts you have worked on.

Any experience with vacation rentals, Airbnb/Vrbo, travel, tourism, hospitality or real estate.

The design and video-editing software you normally use.

Your preferred hourly rate.

Your current weekly availability.

Please Also Answer This Question



Imagine we send you 12 beautiful photographs of a vacation rental dining room decorated for Thanksgiving.



The home is located in Muskegon, Michigan, near Lake Michigan, and we want to encourage November and Thanksgiving bookings.



Without us telling you what kind of post to make, what would you create from these photographs and why?



We are specifically looking for someone who can think creatively and independently, so your answer to this question is important to us.



Final candidates may be invited to complete a small paid creative test project using actual photos and videos from one of our vacation rental properties.



We are hoping to find someone who enjoys this type of work and would like to build a long-term working relationship with our company.

Hours and working arrangement

How to apply

title: Senior SEO & GEO Specialist – Help Us Scale 40+ Clients
description:
# Senior SEO & GEO Specialist



**Remote | Philippines | 10–15 hours/week | $15–25/hour | Long-term opportunity**



We are looking for an experienced **Senior SEO & GEO Specialist** to become the technical and strategic SEO expert behind our growing client portfolio.



We currently manage SEO for approximately **35–40 Danish businesses** and want to significantly grow our SEO MRR while maintaining — and improving — the quality of our work and client retention.



This is **not a junior SEO role**.



We are willing to pay up to **$25/hour for someone who is genuinely excellent**.



We prefer 15 hours from an outstanding SEO specialist over 40 hours from an average one.



## About the Role



Your primary responsibility will be the **actual SEO and GEO work behind our client portfolio**.



You will not primarily be responsible for customer communication.



We already have a team member who manages customer communication, coordination and follow-up.



Your job is to be the **SEO expert behind the work**.



You will:



**Analyze ? Prioritize ? Execute ? Measure ? Document ? Recommend what happens next.**



We don't want someone who simply runs an Ahrefs or Semrush audit and sends us a list of 100 errors.



We want someone who can look at a website and determine:



**"What are the most important things we can do to improve this client's organic performance?"**



## SEO Strategy & Execution



You should have strong experience with:



* SEO strategy

* Keyword research

* Search intent

* SERP analysis

* Competitor analysis

* Google Search Console

* GA4

* Ahrefs, Semrush or similar tools

* On-page SEO

* Content optimization

* Content briefs

* Landing page strategy

* Internal linking

* Site architecture

* Keyword cannibalization

* Indexation

* Crawlability

* Canonicals

* Redirects

* XML sitemaps

* Robots.txt

* Schema / structured data

* Duplicate content

* Broken links

* Diagnosing ranking and traffic declines



Most importantly, you need to know how to **prioritize**.



Finding an SEO problem does not automatically mean it is worth spending time fixing.



We want someone who understands the difference between:



**"This is technically imperfect."**



and:



**"Fixing this is likely to have a meaningful impact."**



## Technical SEO & Website Performance



You will NOT be responsible for building websites.



However, you must be comfortable working hands-on with **existing websites and improving their technical and SEO performance**.



Website performance is an important part of this role.



You should be comfortable investigating and improving:



* Core Web Vitals

* Google PageSpeed Insights

* Lighthouse

* LCP

* INP

* CLS

* Website loading speed

* Mobile performance

* Image optimization

* Image compression

* WebP / AVIF

* Lazy loading

* Caching

* CDN configuration

* WordPress performance

* Plugin performance

* Fonts

* CSS and JavaScript optimization

* Render-blocking resources

* Third-party scripts

* Server response issues

* JavaScript-related SEO issues



We don't want someone who simply tells us:



**"The website is slow."**



We want someone who investigates **why** it is slow and improves the things that can reasonably be improved on the existing website.



For example, if a WordPress website has poor Core Web Vitals because of oversized images, unnecessary plugins, caching configuration or render-blocking resources, you should be comfortable investigating and improving these issues.



You are NOT expected to be a full-stack developer.



If something genuinely requires development work, you should be able to clearly document:



**What is wrong ? Why it matters ? What needs to change ? How we verify the fix afterwards.**



You should then verify that the developer's solution actually fixed the problem.



The goal is:



**Make our clients' existing websites perform better — technically, in search engines and for users.**



## GEO / AI Search



We want GEO / AI Search to become a natural part of our SEO offering.



You should therefore be actively interested in and working with:



* GEO / Generative Engine Optimization

* AI Search

* AI Overviews

* LLM visibility

* Entity and brand signals

* Brand mentions and citations

* Structured data

* Topical authority

* Content structure for AI discovery

* Clear question/answer content

* Original and first-party information

* Authority and trust signals

* How traditional SEO influences AI visibility

* Measuring and monitoring AI visibility where reasonably possible



We do NOT expect you to claim that you have completely "solved GEO."



This area is developing quickly.



We prefer someone who tests, learns and thinks critically.



We want you to understand:



**What appears to actually work — and what is just GEO hype.**



## Link Building & Authority



We also want to develop our authority/link-building offering.



You should understand:



* Backlink analysis

* Competitor backlink analysis

* Link gaps

* Relevance

* Authority

* Anchor text

* Toxic/spammy links

* Link quality

* Authority gaps



You should be able to identify when link building could genuinely help a client.



But you should also be comfortable saying:



**"Links are not the priority for this client right now."**



We are not interested in hundreds of cheap, low-quality backlinks.



Quality, relevance and business impact matter.



## Client Retention



We currently manage approximately **35–40 SEO clients** and intend to grow.



Keeping our existing clients is just as important as acquiring new ones.



Part of your responsibility will therefore be helping us identify clients that require attention before they become dissatisfied.



We want to gradually classify accounts based on things such as:



**Healthy**

Performance and work are developing as expected.



**Attention**

Performance is stagnating or there are issues/opportunities requiring attention.



**Risk**

There is a significant decline, technical problem or other concern.



**Opportunity**

There is a clear opportunity for additional organic growth.



We want to become increasingly proactive.



If a client's organic traffic suddenly starts declining, we want to know and investigate **before the client asks us why**.



## Identify Growth Opportunities



We also want you to identify opportunities that can create additional value for our clients.



This could include:



* Link building

* Authority improvements

* Additional landing pages

* Content opportunities

* GEO opportunities

* Technical improvements

* Competitor gaps

* Content gaps

* New keyword opportunities



You will not primarily be responsible for selling these services.



Your responsibility is to identify and explain the **business and SEO opportunity**.



Our customer-facing team can then discuss it with the client.



## Documentation Is Essential



This is extremely important.



Our customer coordinator needs to understand what has been done so that the work can be communicated clearly to the client.



After working on a client, you should document:



### WHAT DID YOU FIND?



What did your analysis show?



### WHAT DID YOU DO?



What did you actually change or implement?



### WHY?



Why was this work prioritized?



### RESULT / MONITORING



What happened, or what should we monitor going forward?



### NEXT ACTION



What should happen next?



We never want a situation where someone asks:



**"What did we actually do for this client this month?"**



and nobody can answer clearly.



## Working With Our Customer Coordinator



You will work alongside an existing team member who is responsible for customer communication and coordination.



The ideal workflow is:



**You identify and execute the SEO/GEO work**



?



**You document what was done and why**



?



**Our coordinator communicates clearly with the client**



?



**You continue monitoring performance and determining the next priorities**



This allows you to spend the majority of your time on SEO rather than customer service.



## Help Us Build a Scalable SEO Operation



We are not only hiring you to complete tasks.



We also want your expertise to help us improve **how we deliver SEO across the entire portfolio**.



Over time, we want your input on:



* What should happen when a new SEO client starts?

* What should we check every month?

* What should we check quarterly?

* How should we monitor 40+ clients efficiently?

* How do we identify clients at risk?

* How should we prioritize work?

* How should SEO work be documented?

* How should GEO be incorporated into our product?

* How should we identify growth opportunities?

* What should be standardized?

* What can be automated?

* What requires senior expertise?

* What can be delegated to other team members?



We want to build a system that can support significantly more clients **without sacrificing quality**.



## Danish Websites



Our clients are primarily Danish businesses.



The websites, keywords, Search Console queries, content and other information you work with will therefore often be in **Danish**.



You do NOT need to speak Danish.



Our internal communication with you will be in **English**.



You should be comfortable using tools such as **ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI tools** to translate and understand Danish content independently.



However, simply translating a keyword from English to Danish is not SEO research.



You still need to use:



* SERP analysis

* Search Console

* Keyword data

* Competitors

* Search intent

* Actual search behavior



to determine what Danish users are searching for.



Language should not prevent you from doing excellent SEO.



## AI Is Part of the Workflow



You should be highly comfortable using modern AI tools.



We encourage the intelligent use of AI for:



* Research

* Translation

* Data analysis

* Content analysis

* Content briefs

* Identifying patterns

* Documentation

* SOP creation

* Workflow improvements

* Brainstorming

* Scaling repetitive parts of SEO



But we are NOT looking for someone who generates generic AI content and calls it SEO.



**AI should make your SEO expertise more productive — not replace your SEO expertise.**



## Who We Are Looking For



You are:



* A genuinely experienced SEO specialist

* Strong in technical SEO

* Strong in on-page SEO

* Strong with Google Search Console

* Comfortable improving existing website performance

* Analytical

* Commercially aware

* Excellent at prioritizing

* Comfortable working hands-on

* Curious about GEO and AI Search

* Knowledgeable about authority and link building

* Comfortable challenging assumptions

* Proactive

* Good at documenting your work

* Comfortable working independently

* Comfortable using AI

* Able to explain complex SEO issues simply

* Interested in improving systems and processes



Most importantly:



**You think like an SEO specialist, not an SEO checklist.**



## Hours & Compensation



We are initially looking for:



**10–15 hours per week**



Compensation:



**$15–25 USD/hour depending on experience and skill level.**



We are willing to pay toward the higher end for someone who is genuinely excellent.



We prefer:



**15 hours from an excellent specialist**



over



**40 hours from an average specialist.**



This is intended to be a long-term position.



As our SEO portfolio grows, there may be opportunities for additional hours and responsibility.



## How to Apply



Please start your application with:



**"SEO is about priorities."**



Applications that do not start with these words will not be considered.



Please include:



1. A short introduction.

2. Your CV/resume.

3. How many years you have worked professionally with SEO.

4. Your strongest SEO skills.

5. Your experience with technical SEO.

6. Examples of website performance/Core Web Vitals improvements you have personally implemented.

7. Your experience with Google Search Console.

8. Your experience with Ahrefs, Semrush or similar tools.

9. Your experience with link building and authority.

10. Your experience with GEO / AI Search.

11. How you currently use AI in your SEO work.

12. Your expected hourly rate.

13. Your weekly availability.



## Please Answer These Questions



**1. A website loses 30% of its organic clicks over three months. What are the first things you investigate, and why?**



**2. A client's website has poor Core Web Vitals. PageSpeed shows multiple problems. Walk us through how you d
 what actually needs to be fixed and what you would personally implement.**



**3. You only have two hours available for a client this month. How do you d
 what to work on?**



**4. A competitor has significantly more backlinks than our client. Does that automatically mean we should build links? Explain your thinking.**



**5. What do you currently believe is genuinely important for GEO / AI Search visibility — and what do you think is mostly hype?**



**6. Tell us about an SEO recommendation you deliberately chose NOT to implement because something else was more important.**



## Paid Practical Test



Selected candidates will be invited to complete a **paid practical SEO test**.



You will receive a real website and realistic data.



We will ask you to analyze the situation and tell us:



* What you found

* What concerns you

* What opportunities you see

* What you would prioritize

* What you would NOT spend time on

* What you would personally implement

* What requires a developer

* What you would do over the next 90 days

* Why



We are NOT interested in who can produce the longest SEO audit.



We are interested in who can identify:



**What actually matters.**



If you are an experienced SEO specialist who enjoys solving difficult problems, improving websites, working with data and helping build a scalable SEO operation, we would like to hear from you.

We are specifically looking for someone who could grow with the company.

* Managing additional social media accounts

*
 management

* Client follow-up

* Administrative work

HOW TO APPLY

- A front-row seat at the intersection of financial journalism and AI – shaping how news is made

title: Acquisition Specialist – Cold Caller & Closer
description:
Acquisition Specialist – Cold Caller & Closer



(Single Point of Accountability | Performance-Only | Zero Handoffs)



WARNING:

Apply only if you have verified experience in both outbound cold calling and direct-to-seller closing. If you require handoffs, coaching, or flexible standards, this is not for you.



Role Overview



You are solely responsible for generating, qualifying, and closing distressed property deals (unpaid taxes, inheritance, title issues, problem properties).

You will be measured and retained based exclusively on daily call output, pipeline quality, and contracts closed—no exceptions.



Your Responsibilities



100+ live cold call conversations per day (not dials—actual conversations logged and recorded)



Immediate qualification/disqualification using a fixed criteria set—no “relationship building” without outcome



Full-cycle deal management: Personally negotiate, contract, and close each deal—no handoffs at any stage



Accurate, real-time CRM entry for every contact, note, and pipeline movement



Follow strict process: All activity and results tracked and audited. Miss metrics for any reason = immediate removal



Who You Must Be



Proven in both cold calling (high daily volume) and full-cycle closing (real estate or equivalent asset class)



Able to provide daily metrics and references—not negotiable



Rigid about pipeline management, documentation, and transparent reporting



Comfortable with direct feedback and negative coaching—no sensitivity to high-rejection or blunt performance management



Compensation-driven, with a clear history of thriving under performance-only pay plans



Immediate Disqualifiers



No resume or lack of specific metrics for calls/deals



No voice memo, or memo not following exact instructions below



History of team-selling, “split” process roles, or reluctance to own the full sales cycle



Evidence of missed quotas, resistance to feedback, or incomplete reporting



Application Process



1. Submit your resume clearly listing outbound + closing experience, including your highest daily call volume and annual closed deals.

2. Submit a 2–3 minute, unscripted voice memo (no script, no edits) covering, in order:



Your name, country, and highest daily cold call volume in a sales role



An example of a distressed or complicated deal you personally closed (describe steps and outcome)



Your personal system for tracking activity, pipeline, and follow-ups



The most direct/negative feedback you’ve received about your sales process and what changed after



Why you want a single-point, output-only sales role (not team selling or account management)



Any deviation from these steps = immediate rejection.



Do Not Apply If:



You lack both cold calling and direct closing experience with provable metrics



You need daily encouragement, “culture,” or ongoing training



You resist process, documentation, or daily scorecard reporting



You want a collaborative/”team” sales role

title: Industrial Piping Estimator - Takeoff from Isometric Drawings (QA)
description:
Purplefish is a well-funded tech startup based in New York City. We build software that does automated material and labor takeoff from piping isometric drawings for industrial contractors and pipe fabricators in the US. Our QA team already includes 2 amazing teammates in the Philippines who have been with us for over two years, and we're growing it.



REQUIRED: 

1) MUST have industrial piping estimation including labor takeoff from piping ISOs.

2) Can work roughly 4-8pm EST, Mon-Thurs



THIS IS NOT A TRADITIONAL ESTIMATION JOB. You'll use your estimation skills in a new way: checking the work of software instead of producing bids. It's a rare chance to sit at the intersection of tech and the trade you know. Your findings directly shape how the product improves every week, and you'll get deep exposure to how modern software is built while doing work only an experienced piping estimator can do.







WHAT YOU'LL DO

- QA our software's take-offs from piping ISOs: find mistakes, missed items, and wrong counts

- Do independent manual material take-offs (MTO) from isometric drawing packages so we can compare results and measure accuracy

- Count welds and do labor takeoff from ISOs, which means genuinely interpreting the drawings, not just counting symbols

- Build clean bills of materials (BOM) and document errors so our engineers can fix them

- Help us understand where the software falls short of what a real estimator would catch



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Industrial Piping Estimators

- Real experience doing material AND labor takeoffs from piping isometrics (industrial work: oil and gas, chemical, power, process plants). Quantity surveying (QS) or mechanical engineering backgrounds welcome

- You can read ISOs, spool drawings, and spec sheets confidently: fittings, valves, welds, bolt-ups, pipe schedules. P&ID experience is a plus, not required

- Detail-obsessed. You enjoy finding the error nobody else caught

- Strong written and spoken English. You'll be explaining errors to a US engineering team

- Strong Excel skills. AutoCAD experience is a plus

-Part time and full time are both a possibility





OUR HIRING PROCESS

Shortlisted candidates will do a live takeoff assessment over video call, where you'll walk us through a take-off from a real ISO package and explain your reasoning as you go. This role requires genuine, demonstrated skill reading isometrics. Please only apply if you're confident doing this work live.



WHY JOIN

- Stable, long-term role with a funded company, not project work that dries up

- Work directly with the founders and engineering team

- Your expertise is the product's quality bar. This role has real influence



TO APPLY

Tell us briefly about your experience doing material and labor takeoffs from ISOs, including weld counting. Also your preferred hours/time zone.

title: Elite US Real Estate Cold Caller — $4-$5/hr + Big Bonuses (Top 1% Only)

You call property owners from a list my CRM has already scored and prioritized. It tells you who to call next and exactly why they are motivated before you dial, and it logs the call while you talk. You qualify them on condition, timeline, motivation and price, then hand me the ones worth an offer. You will never buy your own data or guess who to dial.

dials a day.

UNCAPPED BONUSES ON TOP

WHAT I ACTUALLY NEED

- You have run a real dialer: Mojo, ReadyMode, CallTools, BatchDialer, Xencall or similar.

DO NOT APPLY IF

You have never called US homeowners. You need a script read word for word and freeze when the seller goes off it. You go quiet for a day without telling anyone.



HOW TO APPLY — THIS IS THE FIRST TEST

Applications missing any step go unread. I am not being difficult. I am measuring whether you follow instructions under a little pressure, because that is exactly the job.

2. How many years of US real estate calling, and for which company.

3. Which dialer you used, and one thing you hated about it.

4. Your backup internet AND backup power setup.



Follow all four and I read every word. Interviews are happening now.



— Deion Johnson, Owner, Johnson Cornerstone Group LLC

We already have a team member in the Philippines who has worked with us for more than four years. We value good people and long-term working relationships and are looking for someone who would also like to grow with us over time.



This is not a general administrative VA role.



Main Responsibility: Weebly to Webflow Migration

Our existing website is currently built on Weebly.

We are progressively migrating the website and its existing content to Webflow while improving its design, structure and presentation.



Your website work will include:

• Migrating existing pages and content from Weebly to Webflow

• Creating and formatting Webflow pages

• Improving page layouts and presentation

• Updating existing website content

• Publishing and formatting blog articles

• Adding images, internal links and other website content

• Checking pages across desktop and mobile

• Implementing basic on-page SEO

• Making ongoing website improvements



If there is no urgent video or content work, continuing the website migration will be your regular ongoing task.

Previous Webflow experience is preferred, but it is not essential.



If you already have good website development or CMS experience and are confident you can learn Webflow quickly, we would still like to hear from you.



Video and Digital Content

We also regularly produce professional and educational content.

We will provide the ideas, specialist information, written material and raw video recordings.

Your role will be to turn this material into finished digital content, including:

• Editing YouTube videos

• Creating YouTube Shorts and other short-form videos

• Creating attractive YouTube thumbnails

• Creating simple graphics

• Preparing videos for publication

• Repurposing videos and articles for social media

• Publishing and scheduling approved content

You will not be expected to do all of these tasks at the same time.



Website migration will be your regular ongoing work. Video and digital content tasks will take priority when new material becomes available.



You are also not expected to be equally strong in every area. Website capability is our most important requirement, followed by video editing.



You will not be expected to develop our overall marketing strategy or create specialist professional content from scratch. We will provide the subject matter and direction.



What We Are Looking For

The most important things for us are:

1. Good website and technical ability

2. Good video editing skills

3. Good visual and design judgement

4. Basic SEO and website publishing knowledge

5. Familiarity with social media content

6. Reliability and attention to detail

7. Ability to work independently

8. Ability to learn new tools quickly

9. Good written English and communication

We do not expect you to be an expert in everything.



If you are particularly strong in website work and reasonably good at video editing and design, we would be very interested in hearing from you.



AI

You do not need to be an AI expert.

Basic familiarity with Gemini, ChatGPT or similar AI tools is sufficient. We already have our own prompts and workflows that we can share with you.



We are much more interested in your practical website, video and creative abilities.



How We Work

You will work directly with the business owner in New Zealand and receive your priorities and instructions directly from him.

We will provide clear guidance and systems when you start. As you become familiar with the role, we would like you to become increasingly independent and take ownership of your work.



We appreciate people who can identify problems, solve them and suggest improvements when they see a better way of doing something.



The work can generally be completed flexibly, although reliable communication and reasonable availability during agreed times will be important.



We are looking for a long-term working relationship rather than someone interested only in completing the website migration and moving on.



For the right person, there may be opportunities for increased hours, responsibility and compensation over time.

Compensation will depend on your skills, experience and agreed working arrangement. Please tell us your expected hourly rate or monthly salary in PHP when applying.



How to Apply

To show that you have read the full job post, please start your application with the words:

WEB + VIDEO



Then provide:

1. A brief introduction about yourself and your current work or study situation

2. Your availability and how many hours per week you can work

3. Your expected hourly rate or monthly salary in PHP

4. Links to websites or webpages you have personally built, designed or maintained

5. Links to videos you have personally edited

6. Examples of thumbnails or graphics you have created, if available

7. Your experience with Webflow and whether you have previously migrated a website from one platform to another

8. Which is your strongest area: website work, video editing or graphic design



Please keep your application clear and concise.



We are much more interested in seeing examples of your actual work than receiving a long generic cover letter.

If you are technically capable, creative, reliable and looking for a stable long-term role with a New Zealand business, we would be very interested in hearing from you.

title: Video Editor / AI Creative Editor — Jewelry E-Commerce
description:
About Us:



LovEmbrace is a personalised jewelry brand selling engraved necklaces, rings, and bracelets to customers in the UK and US. Our products are emotional, they carry names, birthstones, initials, and dates that mean something to the people wearing them. Our advertising has to carry that same emotional weight while still stopping the scroll.



We advertise primarily on Meta and TikTok, and creative is the single biggest lever on our performance. We test constantly, we move fast, and we're looking for someone who wants to own that process rather than just execute tickets.





The Role:

You'll be our dedicated video editor, producing paid social ad creative on a weekly cycle. Most of your output will support new and upcoming product launches, meaning you'll often be creating compelling video for products with little or no existing footage. That's where AI video generation becomes essential, and it's the part of this role we care most about.



This is a production role with creative input. You won't be handed finished storyboards. You'll be given a product, a hook angle, and a brand direction, and you'll be expected to turn that into something we can put money behind.





What You'll Do:

- Produce finished video ads for Meta (Feed, Reels, Stories) and TikTok, cut to the correct aspect ratios and platform specs

- Generate AI video content for products where we have limited or no live footage. This includes model shots, lifestyle scenes, gifting moments, and B-roll

- Create multiple variations of winning concepts (new hooks, new opening frames, new pacing, new CTAs) so we can isolate what's actually driving performance

- Edit and repurpose UGC, influencer footage, and product photography into ad-ready assets

- Add captions, sound design, licensed music, motion graphics, and on-screen text that match our brand style

- Maintain an organised asset library so past clips, hooks, and endings can be reused quickly

- Adapt creative based on performance feedback. We'll share what's working and what isn't, and you'll iterate on it





Weekly Output Expectations:

- 35-40 hours per week

- Creating several new ad concepts per week, built around distinct hooks or angles

- Creating variations and iterations of existing concepts for iterative testing

- Turnaround on a single requested edit or revision within 72 hours



Volume matters here, but so does quality. A batch of rushed, near-identical cuts is worse than fewer ads that are genuinely different from each other.





Requirements:

- 1+ year of video editing experience, with a portfolio of paid social ads (not wedding videos, not YouTube vlogs. Direct response ad creative)

- Strong hands-on experience with AI video tools. Tell us which ones you use and what you've built with them. We work with tools in the Veo / Sora / Kling / Runway / Higgsfield / HeyGen space, plus AI image generation for stills and scene building

- Fluent in a professional editing suite. Premiere Pro, CapCut, or equivalent

- A real understanding of what makes a paid social ad work: the first 3 seconds, pattern interrupts, pacing, retention, and clear CTAs

- Ability to produce believable, high-quality AI output.  No uncanny hands, warped jewelry, melting text, or obvious artefacts. You know how to iterate on prompts until the result is clean, and you know when to abandon an AI shot and solve it another way

- Excellent written English and reliable, proactive communication

- Reliable high-speed internet and a machine capable of handling video work without constant crashes





Nice to Have:



- Previous experience in jewelry, fashion, beauty, or another visual/gifting-led category

- Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager, and comfort reading basic creative performance metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPC and CPM)

- Experience with creative research and swipe file tools such as Foreplay

- Basic graphic design ability for static ads and thumbnails

- Understanding of music licensing and commercial usage rights for paid ads





What We Offer:

Full-time, long-term remote position with a growing brand

Direct working relationship with the founder. No layers of management, fast decisions

Genuine creative ownership: your ads get real budget behind them, and you'll see exactly how they perform

Room to grow with the business as we scale spend





How to Apply:



Please send the following:



Your portfolio or showreel, with paid social ad work clearly identified

At least one example of AI-generated video you personally created, along with a short note on which tools you used and how you approached it

A few sentences on your favourite ad you've ever seen (any brand) and why you think it worked

Your availability and earliest start date





Screening task: 

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to produce one 15–20 second ad for one of our products using assets we provide plus AI-generated footage. This is how we assess real capability, and it's the most important part of the process.



Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

title: Marketing Strategist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Marketing Strategist who can understand a client's business, identify marketing opportunities, and turn business goals into clear, actionable strategies.



This is not simply an execution role. We need someone who can think strategically, communicate confidently with clients, coordinate with a marketing team, and take ownership of the overall marketing direction.

Develop comprehensive marketing strategies based on each client's goals, target audience, industry, and current performance.

 marketing/newsletters, paid advertising, branding, and lead generation.

Review existing client marketing efforts and identify gaps, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Develop clear marketing priorities, campaign recommendations, timelines, and action plans.

Participate in client meetings and confidently explain strategies, recommendations, and next steps.

Coordinate with SEO specialists, paid ads specialists, designers, developers, copywriters, and other team members to execute strategies.

Ensure marketing deliverables remain aligned with client objectives and brand standards.

Review marketing data and campaign performance and recommend strategic adjustments based on results.

Maintain strong attention to detail while managing multiple clients, priorities, and deadlines.

Help improve internal marketing processes, workflows, systems, and playbooks.

Use AI and automation tools appropriately to improve research, analysis, and productivity without relying on AI to replace strategic thinking.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in marketing strategy, digital marketing, account strategy, or a related role.

Strong experience developing multi-channel digital marketing strategies.

Solid understanding of SEO, content marketing, websites, social media,
 marketing, paid advertising, branding, and lead generation.

Experience managing or developing marketing strategies for multiple clients.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Comfortable communicating directly with clients and presenting strategic recommendations.

Strong organizational and project-management skills.

Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with a remote team.

Agency experience is highly preferred.

Experience working with law firms, attorneys, legal marketing, or professional services is a strong plus.

Ideal Candidate



We're looking for someone who goes beyond completing assigned tasks. The right candidate can look at a client's business and marketing as a whole, determine what is working, what is missing, and what should happen next, and then guide the team toward measurable results.

You will help Lazywaist turn thousands of online conversations into useful insights that influence our content, marketing, partnerships, product development and overall brand strategy.

1. Social & Trend Monitoring

TikTok

Reddit

Lemon8

Xiaohongshu / RED

Changes in sentiment or demand

2. Brand Listening

Customer recommendations

Complaints or concerns

Questions about Lazywaist products

Frequently raised objections

3. Community Intelligence

Your responsibility is to understand:



What consumers are asking

Problems they are trying to solve

Products they are recommending

Common misconceptions

Competitor sentiment
